a: Veyalfinan mufena mishshene tzedadin. ulehachi afneye rachamana livhema mishshene tzedadin, ki hechi dela nigmar min mufena mitztzad echad.

Rav acha bereh derava matne la mishshemeh derabbi elazar lekulla: kol gezera shava sheenah mufena kol ikkar — lemedin umeshivin, mufena mitztzad echad — lerabbi yishmael lemedin veen meshivin, lerabbanan lemedin umeshivin, mufena mishshene tzedadin — divre hakkol lemedin veen meshivin.
Ulerabbanan, may ikka ben mufena mitztzad echad lesheenah mufena kol ikkar?

Nafka minna hecha demashkachat la mufena mitztzad echad, vesheenah mufena kol ikkar, velav lehay it leh pircha, velav lehay it leh pircha — shavkinan sheenah mufena kol ikkar, vegamrinan mimmufena mitztzad echad.
Vehacha, may pircha ikka? mishshum deikka lemifrach: ma leadam, shekken mittamme mechayyim.
Vechen amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hayeynu tama derabbi meir — hoil veneemra bo "yetzira" keadam.
Amar leh rabbi amme: ella meatta hammappelet demut har — immo temea leda, shenneemar "ki hinne yotzer harim uvore ruach"? amar leh: har mi ka mappela? even hi deka mappela, hahu "gush" ikkeri.

Ella meatta hammappelet ruach — tehe immo temea leda, hoil veneemra bo "beria" keadam, dichtiv "uvore ruach"? vechi tema lo mufene, middahava leh lemichtav "yotzer harim veruach", uchetiv "uvore ruach", shema minna leafnoye!
Amar leh: danin divre tora middivre tora, veen danin divre tora middivre kabbala.
(Amar) rabba bar bar channa, amar rabbi yochanan: hayeynu tama derabbi meir — hoil veenehem domot keshel adam.
Ella meatta, hammappelet demut nachash tehe immo temea leda, hoil vegalgal eno agolo keshel adam! vechi tema hachi name, litne nachash!
I tena nachash, hava amena: benachash hu difligi rabbanan aleh derabbi meir, dela ketiv beh "yetzira", aval behema vechayya — la peligi, dichtiva (beh) [beyhu] "yetzira".
Veha gabbe mumin katane la: et sheggalgal eno agol keshel adam! la kashya — ha beukkama, ha betzirya.

Rabbi yannay amar: hayeynu tama derabbi meir — hoil veenehem holchot lifnehem keshel adam. vahare of, deen enav holchot lefanav, vekaamar rabbi meir detame! amar abbaye: bekarya vekifofa, uvishar ofot — la.
Metivi: rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: nirin divre rabbi meir bivhema vechayya, vedivre chachamim beofot.
May ofot? illema bekarya vekifofa, may shena behema vechayya deenehen holchot lifnehen keshel adam? karya vekifofa name!
Ella peshita bishar ofot. mikkelal derabbi meir pelig bishar ofot!

Chassore michassera vehachi katane: rabbi chanina ben antignos omer — nirin divre rabbi meir bivhema vechayya, vehu haddin lekarya vekifofa, vedivre chachamim bishar ofot, sheaf rabbi meir lo nechlak immahem ella bekarya vekifofa, aval bishar ofot — mode lehu.
Vehatanya: amar rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok: hammappelet min behema vechayya, ledivre rabbi meir — valad, uledivre chachamim — eno valad. beofot — tibbadek.
Leman tibbadek? lav ledivre rabbi meir, deamar: karya vekifofa — in, shear ofot — la?
Amar rav acha bereh derav ika: la, tibbadek lerabbanan, deamri: karya vekifofa — in, shear ofot — la.
Umay shena karya vekifofa mibbehema vechayya? hoil veyesh lahen lesatot keadam.
Bea minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera: lerabbi meir deamar behema bime ishsha valad mealleya hu, kibbel bah aviha kiddushin mahu? lemay nafka minna? leittesore baachotah.
Lememra dechaye? vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav: lo amarah rabbi meir ella hoil uvemino mitkayyem! amar rav acha bar yaakov: ad kan hevio rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera lide gichuch, velo gichech.
Gufa, amar rav yehuda amar rav: lo amarah rabbi meir ella hoil uvemino mitkayyem. amar rav yirmeya middifti:
b: Af anan name tenena: hammappelet kemin behema chayya veof — valad mealleya hu, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: ad sheyyehe bo mitztzurat adam.
Vehammappelet sandal, o shilya, o shafir merukkam, vehayyotze mechuttach — habba acharav bechor lenachala, veeno bechor lechohen. vei salka datach dechaye, habba acharav bechor lenachala mi have?
Amar rava: leolam dechaye, veshane hatam, deamar kera: "reshit ono" — mi shellibbo dave alav, yatza ze sheen libbo dave alav.
Bea minneh rav adda bar ahava meabbaye: lerabbi meir, deamar behema bime ishsha valad mealleya hu — adam bime vehema may? lemay nafka minneh? leishteroye baachila.
Vetifshot leh meha derabbi yochanan, deamar rabbi yochanan: hashshochet et habbehema umatza bah demut yona — asura baachila!
Hachi hasheta? hatam — la perasot ikka, vela parsa ikka; hacha — nehi difrasot lekka, parsa miha ikka.
Vachachamim omrim: kol sheen bo kulei. amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav: hakkol modim: gufo tayish ufanav adam — adam, gufo adam ufanav tayish — velo chelum.
Lo nechleku ella sheppanav adam, venivra beayin achat kivhema. sherabbi meir omer mitztzurat adam, vachachamim omrim kol tzurat adam.
(Amar lo) [amaru leh rabbanan] lerav yirmeya bar abba: veha ippecha tanya, rabbi meir omer: "kol tzurat", vachachamim omrim: "mitztzurat"! amar lehu: i tanya — tanya.

Amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba, amar rabbi yochanan: metzach, vehaggevinim, vehaenayim, vehallesatot, vegabbot hazzakan — ad sheyyehu kullam keechat. rava amar chassa: metzach, vehaggavin, vehaayin, vehalleset, vegabbat hazzakan — ad sheyyehu kullam keechat.
Vela feligi: ha keman deamar "kol tzurat", ha keman deamar "mitztzurat".
Metivi: tzurat panim sheamru — afillu partzuf echad min happartzufin, chutz min haozen. lememra demechad name saggi?
Amar abbaye: ki tanya hahi leakkev tanya, ucheman deamar kol tzurat, veibbaet ema: leolam keman deamar mitztzurat, umay "echad" — echad echad.
Amar rava: nivra beayin achat uveyarech echad — min hatztzad, immo temea; baemtza, immo tehora.
Amar rava: vishto nakuv — immo temea, vishto atum — immo tehora.
Tanu rabbanan: hammappelet guf atum — en immo temea leda. veezehu guf atum? rabbi omer: kede sheyyinnatel min hachay veyamut.
Vechamma yinnatel min hachay veyamut? rabbi zakkay omer:

a: Ad haarkubba. rabbi yannay omer: ad linkavav, rabbi yochanan omer mishshum rabbi yose ben yehoshua: ad mekom tabburo.
Ben rabbi zakkay lerabbi yannay ikka venayyhu "terefa chayya", mar savar "terefa chayya", umar savar "terefa enah chayya".
Ben rabbi yannay lerabbi yochanan, ikka venayyhu derabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: (nittal) [nittela] yarech vechalal shellah — nevela.
Amar rav pappa: machloket millematta lemala, aval millemala lematta afillu kol dehu — tehora. vechen amar rav giddel amar rabbi yochanan: hammappelet et sheggulegolto atuma — immo tehora.
Veamar rav giddel, amar rabbi yochanan: hammappelet kemin appakuta dedikla — immo tehora.
Ittemar: hammappelet mi sheppanav musemasim, rabbi yochanan amar: immo temea, resh lakish amar: immo tehora.

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: hammappelet yad chatucha veregel chatucha — immo temea leda, veen choshshin shemma migguf atum bata. veim ita, litne: shemma migguf atum o mimmi sheppanav musemasin!
Amar rav pappe: befanav musemasin — kulle alma la peligi ditmea, ki peligi — befanav tuchot, veippecha ittemar: rabbi yochanan amar immo tehora, veresh lakish amar immo temea.
Velotveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan meha! mishshum deshanni leh: hayeynu guf atum, hayeynu mi sheppanav tuchot.
Bene rabbi chiyyay nefuk lekiryayta, ato lekammeh daavuhon, amar lahem: kelum ba maase leyedchem? amru lo: panim tuchot ba leyadenu, vetimmenuha.
Amar lahem: tzeu vetaharu ma shettimmetem. may datayychu, lechumera? chumera deatya lide kulla hi, dekayahavitu la yeme tohar.
Ittemar: hammappelet beriyya sheyyesh lah shene gabbim ushene shidraot, amar rav: beishsha — eno valad, bivhema — asur baachila. ushemuel amar: beishsha — valad, bivhema — muttar baachila.
Bemay kamippalgi? bidrav chanin bar abba, deamar rav chanin bar abba: "hashshesua" — beriyya sheyyesh lah shene gabbin ushene shidraot.
Rav amar: beriyya bealma leta, vechi agmereh rachamana lemoshe — bime immah agmereh. ushemuel amar: bereh bealma ita, vechi agmereh rachamana lemoshe — bealma agmereh, aval bime immah — sharya.

Etiveh rav shimi bar chiyyay lerav: rabbi chanina ben antignos omer, kol sheyyesh lo shene gabbin ushene shidraot pasul laavoda, alma dechaye, vekashya lerav! amar leh: shimi at! sheshshidrato akumma.
Metivi: yesh beubbarin shehen asurin — ben arbaa ledakka, ben shemona legassa, hemennu ulematta asur. yatza mi sheyyesh lo shene gabbin ushene shidraot.
May "yatza"? lav yatza mikkelal ubbarin, sheafillu bime imman asurin?
Rav metaretz letameh, ushemuel metaretz letameh. rav metaretz letameh: ben arbaa ledakka, ben shemone legassa, hemennu ulematta — asur.
Bamme devarim amurim? kesheyyatza laavir haolam, aval bime immo — shere. yatza mi sheyyesh lo shene gabbin ushene shidraot, daafillu bime immo name asur.
b: Ushemuel metaretz letameh: ben arbaa ledakka, ben shemone legassa — hemennu ulematta asur. bamme devarim amurim? beshello kalu lo chodashav, aval kalu lo chodashav — muttar. yatza mi sheyyesh lo shene gabbin ushene shidraot, deaf al gav dechalu lo chodashav — im yatza laavir haolam asur, bime immo shere.

Tane tanna kammeh derav: hammappelet beriyyayt guf sheeno chatuch, uveriyyayt rosh sheeno chatuch, yachol tehe immo temea leda? talmud lomar "ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar vegomer uvayyom hashshemini yimmol vegomer" —
Mi sherauy livrit shemona, yatzu ellu sheenan reuyin livrit shemona. amar leh rav vesayyem ba hachi: vesheyyesh lo shene gabbin ushene shidraot.

Rabbi yirmeya bar abba savar lemebad ovada kevavteh dishmuel, amar leh rav huna: may dataych lechumera? chumera deate lide kulla hu, dekayahavat la deme tohar. aved miha kevateh derav, dekayyma lan hilcheta kerav beissure, ben lekulla ben lechumera.
Amar rava: hare amru, ishsha yoledet letisha veyoledet leshiva, behema gassa yoledet letisha — yoledet leshiva o lo yalda?
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ta shema, hemennu ulematta asur. may lav aggassa? la, addakka.
Hay may? i amrat bishlama aggassa — itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil uveishsha chaye, bivhema name chaye, ka mashma lan dela chaye.
Ella i amrat addakka ittemar, peshita! bat telata yarche mi ka chaye?!
Itzterich, salka datach amina: kol betzir tere yarche chaye, ka mashma lan.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hammappelet demut lilit, immo temea leda, valad hu ella sheyyesh lo kenafayim. tanya name hachi: amar rabbi yose, maase besimonya beachat shehippila demut lilit, uva maase lifne chachamim veamru: valad hu ella sheyyesh lo kenafayim.
Hammappelet demut nachash, hora chanina ben achiv shel rabbi yehoshua: immo temea leda. halach rabbi yosef vesipper devarim lifne rabban gamliel, shalach lo rabbi yehoshua: haneheg ben achicha vavo.

Bahalichatan, yatzta kallat (rabbi) chanina likrato, amra lo: rabbi, hammappelet kemin nachash mahu? amar lah: immo tehora. amra lo: vahalo mishshimcha amra li chamoti immo temea? veamar lah: meeze taam? hoil vegalgal eno agol keshel adam. mittoch devareha nizkar rabbi yehoshua, shalach lo lerabban gamliel: mippi hora chanina.
Amar abbaye: shema minna, tzureba merabbanan deamar milleta — lema ba tama, dechi madkeru leh — middechar.
Mishna hammappelet shafir male mayim, male dam, male geninim — enah chosheshet levalad. veim haya merukkam — teshev lezachar velinkeva. hammappelet sandal o shilya — teshev lezachar velinkeva.
Gemara bishlama dam umayim — lo kelum hi, ella geninim — nechush shemma valad hava venimmoach? amar abbaye: kamma yayin chay shatat immo shel ze shennimmoach ubbarah betoch meeha?
Rava amar: "male" tenan, veim ita deittemoche ittemach — michsar [hava] chasar. rav adda bar ahava amar: "gevavnim" tenan, veim ita deittemoche ittemach — kulle bechad gavvna have kae.

Tanya, abba shaul omer: kover metim hayiti, vehayiti mistakkel baatzamot shel metim. hashshote yayin chay — atzmotav serufin, mazug — atzmotav sechuyin, karauy — atzmotav meshuchin. vechol mi sheshshetiyyayto merubba maachilato — atzmotav serufin, achilato merubba mishshetiyyayto — atzmotav sechuyin, karauy — atzmotav meshuchin.

Tanya, abba shaul omer, veittema rabbi yochanan: kover metim hayiti. paam achat ratzti achar tzevi, venichnasti bekulit shel met, veratzti acharav shalosh parsaot, utzevi lo higgati, vekulit lo kalta. keshechazarti laachoray, amru li: shel og melech habbashan hayta.
Tanya, abba shaul omer: kover metim hayiti. paam achat niftecha meara tachtay, veamadti begalgal eno shel met ad chotmi. keshechazarti laachoray, amru: ayin shel avshalom hayta.

Veshemma tomar: abba shaul nannas hava — abba shaul aroch bedoro hava verabbi tarfon maggia lichtefo, verabbi tarfon aroch bedoro hava verabbi meir maggia lichtefo, rabbi meir aroch bedoro hava verabbi maggia lichtefo, rabbi aroch bedoro hava

Verabbi chiyyay maggia lichtefo, verabbi chiyyay aroch bedoro hava verav maggia lichtefo, rav aroch bedoro hava verav yehuda maggia lichtefo, verav yehuda aroch bedoro hava veadda dayyayla maggia lichtefo,

a: Perashtevina defumebdita kae leh leadda dayyayla ad palgeh, vechulle alma kae lifrashtevina defumebdita ad chartzeh.
Shaalu lifne rabbi: hammappelet shafir male basar mahu? amar lahem: lo shamati.
Amar lefanav rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: kach amar abba — male dam temea nidda, male basar temea leda.
Amar loy: ilmale devar chadash amarta lanu mishshum avicha — shemanucha. achshav,
Middeha kammayyta kichidaa kaamar — kesomchos sheamar mishshum rabbi meir, ha name — shemma kerabbi yehoshua amarah, veen halacha kerabbi yehoshua.
Detanya: hammappelet shafir sheeno merukkam, rabbi yehoshua omer: valad, vachachamim omrim: eno valad.
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum rabbi oshaya: machloket beachur, aval betzalul divre hakkol eno valad. verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: betzalul machloket.
Ibbaya lehu: betzalul machloket, aval beachur divre hakkol valad, o dilma ben baze uven baze machloket? teku.
Metivi: et zo darash rabbi yehoshua ben chananya — "vayyaas Adonai elohim leadam uleishto kotnot or vayyalbishem", melammed sheen hakkadosh baruch hu ose or laadam ella im ken notzar.
Alma: beor talya milleta, la shena achur vela shena tzalul.
I amrat bishlama betzalul machloket — hayeynu deitzterich kera, ella i amrat beachur machloket — lema li kera? sevara bealma hu! ella shema minna: betzalul machloket, shema minna.
Vechen amar rav nachman, amar rabba bar avu: machloket beachur, aval betzalul — divre hakkol eno valad.
Etiveh rava lerav nachman: ella amru, siman valad bivhema dakka — tinnuf, begassa — shilya, beishsha — shafir veshilya.
Veillu shafir bivhema la patar, i amrat bishlama betzalul machloket — mishshum hachi.
Ishsha derabbi ba kera, petar ba shafir; bivhema dela rabbi kera, la petar ba shafir.
Ella i amrat beachur machloket, mikkede sevara hu, may shena ishsha, umay shena behema?
Mi savrat rabbi yehoshua mifshat peshit leh? rabbi yehoshua sappoke mesappeka leh, veazel hacha lechumera vehacha lechumera.
Gabbe ishsha, demamona hu — sefek mamona lekulla.
Gabbe behema, deissura hu deikka legabbe gizza vaavoda — sefek issura lechumera; hachi name gabbe ishsha — sefek tumea lechumera.
Umi mesappeka leh? veha kera kaamar! midderabbanan, ukera asmachta bealma hu.
Amar leh rav chanina bar shelemya lerav: ha rabbi, ha rabbi yishmael berabbi yose, veha rabbi oshaya, veha rabbi yehoshua ben levi — mar keman sevira leh?
Amar leh: ani omer echad ze veechad ze, enah chosheshet.

Ushemuel amar: echad ze veechad ze chosheshet. veazda shemuel letameh, dechi ata rav dimi amar: meolam la dachu shafir binhardea, levar mehahu shefira daata lekammeh dishmuel, demannach aleh chut hassaara mehay gisa vechazye mehay gisa. amar: im ita devalad huy — la hava zig kulle hay.

Veim haya merukkam vechulei. tanu rabbanan: ezehu shafir merukkam? abba shaul omer: techillat beriyyayto merosho, ushete enav kishte tippin shel zevuv. tane rabbi chiyyay: meruchakin ze mizze. shene chovtamin kishte tippim shel zevuv.
Tane rabbi chiyyay: umekoravin ze laze, ufiv matuach kechut hassaara", ugeviyyato kaadasha", veim hayta nekeva — niddona kisora" leorkah.

Vechittuch yadayim veraglayim en lo, vealav meforash bakkabbala: "halo chechalav tatticheni vechaggevinna takpieni or uvasar talbisheni vaatzamot vegidim tesochcheni chayyim vachesed asita immadi ufekuddatcha shamra ruchi".
Veen bodkin oto bemayim — shehammayim azzin
b: Vetordin oto, ella bodkin oto beshemen — shehashshemen rach umetzachtzecho, veen roin ella bachamma.
Ketzad bodkin oto? ketzad bodkin oto?! kidamrinan! ella, bamme bodkin oto leda im zachar hu im nekeva hi?
Abba shaul bar nash, veamri la abba shaul bar remes, omer: mevi kesam sherosho chalak, umenanea beoto makom, im mesachsech — beyadua shezzachar hu, veim lav — beyadua shennekeva hi.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: lo shanu ella millematta lemala, aval min hatztzedadin — ema kotle bet harechem ninhu.
Amar rav adda bar ahava: tana, "im hayta nekeva — nedona kisora seduka". matkef la rav nachman: vedilma chut shel betzim ninhu? amar abbaye: hasheta betzim gufayyhu la yedii, chut shel betzim yedia?
Amar rabbi amram, tana: shete yarchotav kishne chutin shel zehorit. veamar rabbi amram ala: keshel erev. ushene zerootav kishne chutin shel zehorit, veamar rabbi amram ala: keshel sheti.
Amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana, la taaved ovada ad sheyyasir. umi amar shemuel hachi? vehaamar shemuel: achat zo veachat zo chosheshet!
Amar rav amme bar shemuel: ledidi mipparsha li minneh demar shemuel — lachosh chosheshet, yeme tohora la yahavinan la ad sheyyasir.
Lememra dimsappeka leh lishmuel? veha hahu shefira daatay lekammeh demar shemuel, amar: "ha bar arbein vechad yoma", vechashshev miyyoma deazla litvila ad hahu yoma, vela hava ella arbein yomin,
Vaamar lehu: hay benidda beal; kafteh, veodi! shane shemuel, derav guvereh.

Hammappelet sandal vechulei. tanu rabbanan: sandal dome laddag shel yam, mittechillato valad hu, ella shennirtzaf. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: sandal dome lallashon shel shor haggadol. mishshum rabbotenu heidu: sandal tzarich tzurat panim.

Amar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: halacha, sandal tzarich tzurat panim. amar rav adda, amar rav yosef, amar rabbi yitzchak: sandal tzarich tzurat panim, vaafillu meachorav. mashal leadam shessatar et chavero, vehechzir panav laachorav.
Bime rabbi yannay, bikkeshu letaher et hassandal sheen lo tzurat panim. amar lahem rabbi yannay: tihartem et havvevladot!

Vehatanya: mishshum rabbotenu heidu: sandal tzarich tzurat panim! amar rav bivi bar abbaye amar rabbi yochanan: meeduto shel rabbi nechuneya nishnet mishna zo. amar rabbi zeera: zecha ba rav bivi bishmateh, daana vehu havena yatvin kammeh derabbi yochanan ki amra leha shemata, ukedam ihu vaamar uzecha ba.
Lamma hizkiru sandal, vahalo en sandal sheen immo valad?
I deityelida nekeva bahadeh — hachi name, hacha bemay askinan — deityelid zachar bahadeh.
Mahu detema: hoil veamar rav yitzchak bar amme, ishsha mazraat techilla — yoledet zachar, ish mazria techilla — yoledet nekeva, middeha zachar — ha name zachar.
Ka mashma lan: ema shenehem hizriu bevat achat, hay zachar vehay nekeva.
Davar acher: sheim teled nekeva lifne shekiat hachamma, vesandal leachar shekiat hachamma —
Mone techillat nidda larishon, utechillat nidda laacharon.
Sandal ditnan

a: Gabbe bechorot, lemay hilcheta?
Labba acharav — bechor lenachala, veen bechor lechohen.
Sandal ditnan gabbe karetot, lemay hilcheta?
Sheim teled valad derech dofen, vesandal derech rechem — demayyta korban assandal.
Ulerabbi shimon, deamar: yotze derech dofen valad mealleya hu — may ikka lememar?
Amar rabbi yirmeya: sheim teled valad begayyutah, vesandal leachar shennitgayyeyra — demayyta korban assandal.
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa, umi itanhu lehane shinnuye? veha tanya: keshehen yotzin — en yotzin ella keruchin!

Amar rav pappa: shema minna, michrach karech leh valad lesandal appalgeh, umeshalchef leh kelappe resheh. gabbe bechorot, kegon sheyyatzu derech rashehem, desandal kadem venafek. gabbe karetot, sheyyatzu derech margelotehem, devalad kadem venafek.

Rav huna bar tachlifa mishshemeh derava amar: afillu tema metzumetzamin, veefoch shematata. gabbe bechorot — sheyyatzu derech margelotehem, valad deit beh chiyyuta sarech vela nafek, sandal delet beh chiyyuta sharek venafek. gabbe karetot — sheyyatzu derech rashehen, valad deit beh chiyyuta middenafek resheh havya leda, sandal ad denafek rubbeh.
Mishna shilya babbayit — habbayit tame, lo shehashshilya valad, ella sheen shilya belo valad.
Rabbi shimon omer: nimmok havvalad, ad shello yatza.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: shilya — techillatah doma lechut shel erev, vesofah doma ketormos, vachalula kachatzotzeret, veen shilya pechuta mittefach. rabbi shimon ben gamliel omer: shilya dome lekurekvan shel tarnegolin, shehaddakkin yotzin mimmenna.
Tanya: rabbi oshaya zeera demin chavrayya — chamishsha shiuran tefach, veellu hen: shilya, shofar, shidra, dofen sukka, vehaezov.
Shilya — ha daamaran. shofar — detanya: kamma yehe shiur shofar? peresh rabbi shimon ben gamliel: kede sheyyochazennu beyado, veyerae lechan ulechan tefach.

Shidra ma hi? deamar rabbi parnach amar rabbi yochanan: shidro shel lulav tzarich sheyyehe yotze min hahadas tefach. dofen sukka — detanya: shetayim kehilchatan, shelishit afillu tefach. ezov — detane rabbi chiyyay: ezov tefach.
Amar rabbi chanina bar pappa: daresh shela ish kefar temarta — telat matneyata, vetarte shematata, shiura tefach. tarte? chada hi! amar abbaye: ema — amar rabbi chiyyay: ezov tefach.
Vetu lekka? vehaikka tefach al tefach al rum tefach merubba — mevi et hattumea, vechotzetz bifne hattumea.
Tefach kaamrinan, tefach al tefach la kaamrinan.
Veha ikka even hayyotze min hattannur tefach, umin hakkira shalosh etzbaot — chibbur!
Ki kaamrinan hecha divtzir mittefach la chaze, aval hacha, kol shekken divtzir mittefach — yad tannur hu.
Vehaikka
b: Tannure banot tefach! detanya: tannur techillato arbaa usheyarav arbaa, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: bamme devarim amurim? begadol, aval bekatan — techillato kol shehu mishshettiggamer melachto, usheyarav berubbo.
Vechamma "kol shehu"? amar rabbi yannay: tefach, shekken osin tannure banot tefach. biflugeta la kamayyre.
Hasheta daatet lehachi, ha name pelugeta hi. dekatane sefa: amar rabbi yehuda: lo amru tefach ella min hattannur velakkotel.
Vehaikka misgeret tefach! bedichtivan la ka mayyre, vehaikka kapporet tefach, bekadashim la kamayyre.
Vehaikka dayyah lakkora shehi rechava tefach! bidrabbanan la kamayyre, ella bedichtivan vela mefarshi shiurayyhu.

Yatev rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta kammeh derav kahana, veyatev vekaamar: amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol shelosha yamim harishonim tolin et hashshilya bavvalad, mikkan veelach choshshin levalad acher.
Amar leh: umi amar rav hachi? vehaamar rav: en havvalad mitakkev achar chavero kelum! ishtik. amar leh: dilma kan benefel, kan beven kayyayma?

Amar leh: at amrat lishmateteh derav beferush? amar rav hachi: hippila nefel veachar kach hippila shilya — kol shelosha yamim tolin et hashshilya bavvalad, mikkan veelach choshshin levalad acher. yalda veachar kach hippila shilya — afillu mikkan vead asara yamim en choshshin levalad acher.
Shemuel vetalmidi derav verav yehuda havo yatvi, chalef veazel rav yosef bereh derav menashsheya middevil leappayyhu, balay veate. amar: ate lan gavra deramenan leh begila dechitteta umirme umidche.

Addehachi ata, amar leh shemuel: may amar rav beshilya? amar leh: hachi amar rav: en tolin et hashshilya ella bedavar shel keyayma. shayylinhu shemuel lechol talmide derav, veamri leh: hachi. hadar chazyeh lerav yehuda bishut.
Bea minneh rabbi yose ben shaul merabbi: hammappelet demut orev veshilya mahu? amar leh: en tolin ella bedavar sheyyesh bemino shilya.

Keshura bo mahu? amar leh: davar sheeno shaalta. etiveh: hammappelet min behema chayya vaof veshilya immahen, bizman shehashshilya keshura immahen — en choshshin levalad acher, en shilya keshura immahen — choshshin levalad acher, hareni metil alehen

a: Chomer shene veladot, sheani omer shemma nimmoach shafir shel shilya venimmocha shilya shel shafir. teyuveta.
Amar rabba bar shela, amar rav matna, amar shemuel: maase vetalu et hashshilya bavvalad ad asara yamim, velo amru tolin ella beshilya habbaa achar havvalad.
Amar rabba bar bar channa, amar rabbi yochanan: maase vetalu et hashshilya bavvalad, ad esrim ushelosha yamim. amar leh rav yosef: ad esrim vearbaa amrat lan.
Amar rav acha bereh derav avvira, amar rabbi yitzchak: maase venishtaha havvalad achar chavero sheloshim ushelosha yom. amar leh rav yosef: sheloshim vearbaa amrat lan.

Hanicha leman deamar yoledet letisha yoledet limkuttain, mashkachat la echad nigmera tzurato lesof shiva, veechad nigmera tzurato litchillat tisha. ella leman deamar yoledet letisha enah yoledet limkuttain, may ikka lememar?
Efoch shematata: sheloshim ushelosha — leshilya, esrim ushelosha — levalad.

Amar rabbi avin bar rav adda, amar rav menachem ish kefar shearim, veamri la bet shearim: maase venishtaha valad echad achar chavero shelosha chodashim, vahare hem yoshvim lefanenu bevet hammidrash. uman ninhu? yehuda vechizkiyya bene rabbi chiyyay.
Veha amar mar: en ishsha mitabberet vechozeret umitabberet! amar abbaye: tippa achat hayta venitchalleka lishtayim, echad nigmera tzurato bitchillat shiva, veechad besof tisha.

Shilya babbayit — habbayit tame. tanu rabbanan: shilya babbayit — habbayit tame, lo shehashshilya valad, ella sheen shilya sheen valad immah, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose verabbi yehuda verabbi shimon metaharin.
Amru lo lerabbi meir: i atta mode sheim hotziuhu besefel labbayit hachitzon, shehu tahor? amar lahen: aval. velamma? lefi sheeno.
Amru lo: keshem sheeno babbayit hachitzon, kach eno babbayit happenimi! amar lahen: eno dome nimmok paam achat, lenimmok shete peamim.
Yatev rav pappa achore derav bivi kammeh derav hamenuna, veyatev vekaamar: may tama derabbi shimon? kasavar kol tumea shennitarev bah mimmin acher — betela.
Amar lehu rav pappa: hayeynu name tamayyhu derabbi yehuda verabbi yose. achichu aleh, may shena? peshita!
Amar rav pappa: afillu ki ha milleta lema inish, vela nishtok kammeh rabbeh, mishshum shenneemar: "im navalta vehitnasse veim zammota yad lefe".
Veazda rabbi shimon letameh, detanya: melo tarvad rakav shennafal letocho afar kol shehu — tame, verabbi shimon metaher.
May tama derabbi shimon? amar rabba: ashkachtinhu lerabbanan deve rav deyatvi vekaamri, i efshar shello yirbu shete peridot afar al perida achat shel rakav, vechasayr leh.
Veamena lehu: adderabba, i efshar shello yirbu shete peridot rakav al
b: Perida achat afar, venafel leh shiura!
Ella amar rabba: hayeynu tama derabbi shimon, sofo kitchillato — ma techillato naase lo davar acher gangilon, af sofo naase lo davar acher gangilon.
May hi? detanya: ezehu met sheyyesh lo rakav, veezehu met sheen lo rakav? nikbar arom bearon shel shayish o al gabbe ritzpa shel avanim — zehu met sheyyesh lo rakav.
Veezehu met sheen lo rakav? nikbar bichsuto, o bearon shel etz, o al gabbe ritzpa shel levenim — zehu met sheen lo rakav. velo amru rakav ella lemet bilvad, lemaote harug dela.
Gufa: melo tarvad rakav shennafal letocho afar kol shehu — tame, verabbi shimon metaher. melo tarvad rakav shennitpazzer babbayit — habbayit tame, verabbi shimon metaher.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan kammayyta — behahi kaamri rabbanan mishshum demikkenif, aval nitpazzer — ema modu leh lerabbi shimon, deen maahil vechozer umaahil.
Vei ashmeinan beha — beha amar rabbi shimon deen maahil vechozer umaahil, aval beha — ema mode lehu lerabbanan, tzericha.
Tanya iddach: melo tarvad veod afar bet hakkevarot — tame, verabbi shimon metaher. may tamayyhu derabbanan? lefi shei efshar limlo tarvad veod afar bet hakkevarot sheen bo melo tarvad rakav.
Hasheta deamrat tama derabbi shimon mishshum sofo kitchillato, gabbe shilya may tama? amar rabbi yochanan: mishshum bittul berov nagu bah.

Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh, deamar rabbi yochanan: rabbi shimon verabbi eliezer ben yaakov amru davar echad. rabbi shimon — ha daamaran, rabbi eliezer — detanya: rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: behema gassa sheshshafa chararat dam, hare zo tikkaver, ufetura min habbechora.
Vetane rabbi chiyyay ala: enah metammea lo bemagga velo bemassa, umeachar sheenah metammea lo bemagga velo bemassa, ammay tikkaver? kede lefarsemah shehi petura min habbechora.
Alma valad mealleya hu, veammay tane rabbi chiyyay: enah metammea lo bemagga velo bemassa? amar rabbi yochanan: mishshum bittul berov nagu bah.
Amar rabbi amme, amar rabbi yochanan: umode rabbi shimon sheimmo temea leda.
Amar hahu sava lerabbi amme: asbera lach tama derabbi yochanan, deamar kera: "ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar vegomer", afillu lo yalda ella keen shehizria — temea leda.
Resh lakish amar: shafir shetterafuhu bememav — naase kemet shennitbalbela tzurato.

Amar leh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: met shennitbalbela tzurato menalan detahor? illema meha deamar rabbi shabbetay amar rabbi yitzchak magdelaa, veamri lah amar rabbi yitzchak magdelaa amar rabbi shabbetay: met shennisraf veshildo kayyemet tame, maase haya vetimmeu lo petachim gedolim

a: Vetiharu lo petachim ketannim. veka dayykat minna: tama deshildo kayyemet, ha lav hachi tahor.
Adderabba, dok minna lehay gisa: shildo kayyemet hu detiharu lo petachim ketannim, ha lav hachi — petachim ketannim name temein, dechol chad vechad chaze leappoke chad chad ever!
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: rabbi yochanan deamar keman? kerabbi eliezer, ditnan: efer serufin, rabbi eliezer omer: shiuran berova.
Hechi dame met shennisraf veshildo kayyemet? amar abbaye: kegon shesserafo al gabbe katvulya. rava amar: kegon shesserafo al gabbe appuderim. ravina amar: kegon deicharach icharoche.
Tanu rabbanan: hammappelet yad chatucha veregel chatucha — immo temea leda, veen choshshin shemma migguf atum bau.
Rav chisda verabba bar rav huna deamri tarvayyhu: en notnin lah yeme tohar. may tama? ema hirchika ledatah.
Metiv rav yosef: hammappelet veen yadua ma hippila teshev lezachar velinkeva, vei salka datach kol kehay gavvna ema hirchika ledatah, litne ulenidda!
Amar abbaye: i tena lenidda, hava amena mevia korban veeno neechol, ka mashma lan deneechol.
Amar rav huna: hotzi ubbar et yado vehechzirah — immo temea leda, shenneemar: "vayhi velidtah vayyitten yad".
Metiv rav yehuda: hotzi ubbar et yado — en immo chosheshet lechol davar! amar rav nachman: ledidi mipparsha li minneh derav huna, lachosh chosheshet, yeme tohar la yahavinan la ad denafek rubbeh.
Veha en "immo chosheshet lechol davar" kaamar! amar abbaye: enah chosheshet lechol davar middeorayyta, aval midderabbanan chosheshet. veha kera kaamar? midderabbanan, ukera asmachta bealma.
Mishna hammappelet tumetum veanderoginos — teshev lezachar velinkeva.
Tumetum vezachar, anderoginos vezachar — teshev lezachar velinkeva; tumetum unekeva, anderoginos unekeva — teshev linkeva bilvad.
Yatza mechuttach, o mesoras — mishsheyyetze rubbo hare hu keyalud. yatza kedarko — ad sheyyetze rov rosho. veezehu rov rosho? mishsheyyetze paddachto.
Gemara hasheta tumetum lechodeh veanderoginos lechodeh (amar) [amrat] teshev lezachar velinkeva, tumetum vezachar, anderoginos vezachar mibbaya?

Itzterich, mahu detema, hoil veamar rabbi yitzchak: ishsha mazraat techilla — yoledet zachar, ish mazria techilla — yoledet nekeva, ema middehay zachar — hay name zachar? ka mashma lan. ema: shenehem hizriu bevat achat, zo zachar veze nekeva.
Amar rav nachman amar rav: tumetum veanderoginos sherau loven o odem — en chayyayvin al biat mikdash, veen sorfin alehem et hatteruma.
Rau loven veodem keechad — en chayyayvin al biat mikdash, aval sorfin alehem et hatteruma, shenneemar "mizzachar vead nekeva
b: Teshallechu" — zachar vadday nekeva vaddait, velo tumetum veanderoginos.

Lema mesayyay leh: tumetum veanderoginos sherau loven o odem — en chayyayvin al biat mikdash, veen sorfin alehem et hatteruma. rau loven veodem keachat — en chayyayvin al biat mikdash, aval sorfin alehem et hatteruma.
May tama, lav mishshum shenneemar "mizzachar vead nekeva teshallechu", zachar vadday, nekeva vaddait, velo tumetum veanderoginos? amar ulla: la, ha manni? rabbi eliezer hi.
Ditnan, rabbi eliezer omer: hashsheretz... venelam mimmennu" — al helem sheretz hu chayyayv, veeno chayyayv al helem mikdash.
Rabbi akiva omer: "venelam mimmennu vehu tame" — al helem tumea hu chayyayv, veeno chayyayv al helem mikdash.
Veamrinan: may benayyhu? veamar chizkiyya: sheretz unevela ikka benayyhu, derabbi eliezer savar: baenan ad deyada i besheretz ittammi i binvela ittammi, verabbi akiva savar: la baenan.
Lav amar rabbi eliezer hatam baenan deyada i besheretz ittammi, i binvela ittammi; hacha name baenan deyada i beloven ittammi, i beodem ittammi.
Aval lerabbi akiva, deamar mishshum tumea michayyayv, hacha name mishshum tumea michayyayv.
Verav, may shena biat mikdash dela, dichtiv: "mizzachar vead nekeva teshallechu" — zachar vadday, nekeva vaddait, velo tumetum veanderoginos.
I hachi, teruma name la nisrof, dichtiv: "vehazzav et zovo lazzachar velannekeva" — zachar vadday, nekeva vaddait, velo tumetum veanderoginos!
Hahu mibbae leh lechidrabbi yitzchak, deamar rabbi yitzchak: "lazzachar" — lerabbot et hammetzora lemayenotav, "velinkeva" — lerabbot et hametzoraat lemayenoteha.
Hay name mibbee leh, bemi sheyyesh lo tohora bammikve — perat lichli cheres, divre rabbi yose!
Im ken, nichtov rachamana "adam".
Vechi tema, i ketav rachamana "adam" hava amena kele mattachot la, mikkol tame lanafesh" nafka! "zachar" unekeva" lema li? lechidrav.
Veema, kulleh lechidrav hu daata? im ken, nichtov "zachar unekeva"! may "mizzachar vead nekeva"? ad kol davar sheyyesh lo tohora bammikve.
I hachi, ki ittammi bishar tumeot, la lishallechu? amar kera "mizzachar" — mittumea happoreshet min hazzachar.
Vechol hecha dichtiv "mizzachar ad nekeva" lemaote tumetum veanderoginos hu daata? veha gabbe arachin dichtiv "hazzachar".

Vetanya: "hazzachar" — velo tumetum veanderoginos. yachol lo yehe beerech ish, aval yehe beerech ishsha? talmud lomar: "hazzachar... veim nekeva" — zachar vadday, nekeva vaddait, velo tumetum veanderoginos.
Tama dichtiv "hazzachar... veim nekeva", ha mizzachar" unekeva" la memaet. hahu mibbae leh

a: Lechallek ben erech ish leerech ishsha.
Yatza mechuttach o mesoras vechulei. amar rabbi elazar: afillu harosh immahen.
Verabbi yochanan amar: lo shanu ella sheen harosh immahen, aval harosh immahen — harosh poter.
Lema bedishmuel kamippalgi, deamar shemuel: en harosh poter binfalim.
Beshalem — dechulle alma la peligi, ki peligi bimchuttach, demar savar: beshalem hu dekachashev, bimchuttach la kachashev, umar savar: bamchuttach name chashev.
Lishshana acharina: tama deyatza mechuttach o mesoras, ha ketikno — harosh poter. tarvayyhu let lehu dishmuel, deamar shemuel: en harosh poter binfalim.
Ikka dematne la leha shemateta beappe nafsha, amar rabbi elazar: en harosh kerov evarim, verabbi yochanan amar: harosh kerov evarim, vekamippalgi bedishmuel.
Tenan: yatza mechuttach o mesoras, mishsheyyetze rubbo — hare hu keyalud. middekaamar "mesoras", mikkelal dimchuttach ketikno, vekaamar mishsheyyetze rubbo hare ze keyalud — kashya lerabbi yochanan!
Amar lach rabbi yochanan, ema: yatza mechuttach umesoras.
Veha "o" katane! hachi kaamar: yatza mechuttach o shalem, veze vaze mesoras — mishsheyyetze rubbo hare ze keyalud.
Amar rav pappa: ketannae, yatza mechuttach o mesoras — mishsheyyetze rubbo hare hu keyalud. rabbi yose omer: mishsheyyetze ketikno. may kaamar?
Amar rav pappa, hachi kaamar: yatza mechuttach umesoras — mishsheyyetze rubbo hare hu keyalud, ha ketikno — harosh poter. rabbi yose omer: mishsheyyetze rubbo ketikno.
Matkef la rav zevid: mikkelal devimsoras, rubbo name lo poter? ha kayyma lan derubbo kechullo!
Ella amar rav zevid, hachi kaamar: yatza mechuttach umesoras — mishsheyyetze rubbo hare ze keyalud, ha ketikno — harosh poter. rabbi yose omer: mishsheyyetze ketikno lechayyim.
Tanya name hachi: yatza mechuttach (o) mesoras — mishsheyyetze rubbo hare ze keyalud, ha ketikno — harosh poter. rabbi yose omer: mishsheyyetze ketikno lechayyim.

Veezehu ketikno lechayyim? mishsheyyetze rov rosho. veezehu rov rosho? rabbi yose omer: mishsheyyetzu tzedaav. abba chanan mishshum rabbi yehoshua omer: (mishsheyyetze) [mishshettetze] paddachto. veyesh omrim: mishsheyyerau karne rosho.
Mishna hammappelet veen yadua mahu — teshev lezachar velinkeva. en yadua im valad haya im lav — teshev lezachar velinkeva ulenidda.
Gemara amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: avra nahar vehippila — mevia korban veneechol, hallech achar rov nashim, verov nashim valad mealleya yaldan.
Tenan: en yadua im valad haya, teshev lezachar velinkeva ulenidda. ammay teshev lenidda? lema: hallech achar rov nashim, verov nashim valad mealleya yaldan.
Matnitin beshello huchezka ubbara, vechi kaamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi — keshehuchezka ubbara.
Ta shema: behema sheyyatza melea, uvaa rekanit — habba acharav bechor missafek.
Veammay? hallech achar rov behemot, verov behemot valad mealleya yaldan, vehay pashut hu!

Amar ravina, mishshum deikka lememar: rov behemot yoldot davar happoter mibbechora, umiutan yoldot davar sheeno poter mibbechora, vechol hayyoldot metannefot, vezo hoil velo tinnefa — ittera le rubba.
I kol hayyoldot metannefot, ha middela metannefa bechor mealleya hu! ella ema: rov yoldot metannefot, vezo hoil velo tinnefa — ittera le rubba.
Ki ata rabbin amar: metiv rabbi yose berabbi chanina toa, vela yadana may teyuveta. may hi? detanya:
b: Ishsha sheyyatzta melea uvaa rekanit, vehevia lefanenu shelosha shavuin tehorin, vaasara shevuot echad tame veechad tahor.

Meshammeshet leor sheloshim vechamesh, umatbilin otah tishim vechamesh tevilot, divre bet shammay. uvet hillel omrim: sheloshim vechamesh. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: dayyah lattevila shettehe baacharona.
Bishlama shavua rishon lo meshammeshet, emar: yoledet zachar hi; shavua sheni, emar: yoledet nekeva hi;
Shavua shelishi, emar: yoledet nekeva bezov hi;
Ella shavua revii, af al gav deka chazya dam — teshammesh, deha dam tahor hu. lav mishshum dela azlinan batar rubba?
Ella may "la yadana may teyuveta"? emar: hirchika ledatah.
Hach shevua chamishi detahor hu, teshammesh!
Hach shavua revii, kol yoma veyoma maspekinan besof leda uvitchillat nidda, veesrin utemanya gufeh emar techillat nidda hi, uvaaya lemetav shiva leniddatah.
Beesrim vechad teshammesh!
Rabbi shimon hi, deamar: "asur laasot ken", shemma tavo lide safek. leureta teshammesh? kesheraata baerev.
Umatbilin otah tishim vechamesh tevilot. shavua kamma matbilin otah belelavata, emar yoledet zachar hi.
Shavua sheni, matbilin otah belelavata, emar: yoledet nekeva hi. (bimama) [bimame], emar: yoledet zachar bezov hi.
Shavua shelishi matbilin la (bimama) [bimame], emar: yoledet nekeva bezov hi.
Belelavata, bet shammay letamayyhu, deamri: tevulat yom aroch bae tevila.

a: Mikkede yeme tohora kamma havu? shittin veshitta. dal shavua shelishi deatbelinan la, pashu lehu shittin neche chada. shittin neche chada utelatin vachamesh — tishin vearba havyayn, tishin vachamesh may avidtayyhu?
Amar rav yirmeya middifti: kegon shebbat lefanenu ben hashshemashot, deyahavinan la tevila yattirta.
Ulevet hillel, deamri: tevulat yom aroch la bae tevila, telatin vachamesh may avidtayyhu?
Esrim utemanya, kedaamaran. hach shavua chamishi matbelinan kol lelya velelya, emar: sof nidda hi.
Asra shavuin lema li? bitmanya ufalga saggi!
Ayyeyde ditna palga deshavua, massek leh, veayyeyde ditna "shavua tame", tena name "shavua tahor".
Vehaikka tevilat zava!
Delifne tashmish kachashev, dilachar tashmish la kachashev.
Ulevet shammay, dechashev dilachar tashmish, nichshov name tevilat zava! beleda kamayyre, beziva la kamayyre.
Vehaikka yoledet bezov? yoledet bezov kachashev, ziva geredta la kachashev.
(Shevuata) [shavua] kamma deatya lekamman, laytbela beyoma, dilma kol yoma veyoma shelimu la sefurim dida!
Ha manni? rabbi akiva hi, deamar: baenan sefurim befanenu.
Sof shavua kamma laytbela! chad beshavua la kamayyre.
Yoma kamma deatya lekamman laytbela, dilma shomeret yom keneged yom hi! bezava gedola kamayyre, bezava ketanna — la kamayyre.
Shema minna telat, shema minna: rabbi akiva hi, deamar: baenan sefurim befanenu.
Ushema minna: rabbi shimon hi, deamar: aval amru chachamim asur laasot ken, shemma tavo lide safek.
Ushema minna: tevila bizmannah mitzva, verabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: dayyah litvila baacharona, vela amrinan tevila bizmannah mitzva.
Mishna hammappelet leyom arbaim — enah chosheshet levalad, leyom arbaim veechad — teshev lezachar velinkeva ulenidda.

Rabbi yishmael omer: yom arbaim veechad teshev lezachar ulenidda, yom shemonim veechad teshev lezachar velinkeva ulenidda, shehazzachar nigmar learbaim veechad, vehannekeva lishmonim veechad. vachachamim omrim: echad beriyyayt hazzachar veechad beriyyayt hannekeva — ze vaze arbaim veechad.
Gemara lamma huzekar zachar?
I lime tumea — ha katane nekeva, vei lime tohora
b: Ha katane nidda!
Sheim tire yom sheloshim vearbaa, vetachzor vetire yom arbaim veechad — tehe mekulekelet ad arbaim ushemona.
Vechen leinyan nekeva, sheim tire yom shivim vearbaa, vetachzor vetire yom shemonim veechad, tehe mekulekelet ad shemonim ushemona.
Rabbi yishmael omer: yom arbaim veechad teshev lezachar ulenidda kulei. tanya, rabbi yishmael omer: timme vetiher bezachar, vetimme vetiher binkeva.
Ma keshettimme vetiher bezachar yetzirato keyotze vo, af keshettimme vetiher binkeva yetziratah kayyotze bah. amru lo: en lemedin yetzira mittumea.

Amru lo lerabbi yishmael: maase bikleoppatra malkat alekkesanderos, shennitchayyeyvu shifchoteha hariga lammalchut, uvedakan umetzaan ze vaze learbaim veechad! amar lahen: ani mevi lachem reayay min hattora, veattem meviin li reayay min hashshotim?!
May reaya min hattora? illema timme vetiher bezachar vetimme vetiher binkeva kulei. ha kaamri leh: en danin yetzira mittumea!
Amar kera "teled", hosif lah hakkatuv leda acheret binkeva.
Umay reaya min hashshotim? emar: nekeva kedim, veiabbur arbein yomin kamme zachar.
Verabbanan: samma denaftza ashkinhu. verabbi yishmael: ikka gufa dela mekabbel samma.

Amar lahem rabbi yishmael: maase bikleppatra malkat yevavnim, shennitchayyeyvu shifchoteha hariga lammalchut, uvedakan umetzaan zachar learbaim veechad, unekeva lishmonim veechad. amru lo: en meviin reaya min hashshotim.
May tama? hach dinkeva iyyaytara arbein yomin, vahadar iabbar.
Verabbi yishmael: leshomer masrinhu. verabbanan: en appotroppos laarayot, ema shomer gufeh ba aleha.
Vedilma: i karuhu lehach dinkeva bearbein vechad, hava mishtachcha kezachar? amar abbaye: besimanehon shavin.
Vachachamim omrim: echad beriyyayt zachar veechad beriyyayt nekeva vechulei. chachamim hayeynu tanna kamma!
Vechi tema lemistema resha kerabbanan, veyachid verabbim — halacha kerabbim, peshita!
Mahu detema: mistabbera tama derabbi yishmael, (dakemaseyya) [dekamsayyeyi] leh kerae, ka mashma lan.

Daresh rabbi simlay: lema havvalad dome bime immo — lefinkas shemmekuppal, umunnach yadav al shete tzedaav, shete atzilav al shete archubbotav, ushene akevav al shete agvotav, verosho munnach lo ben birkav, ufiv satum, vetabburo patuach. veochel mimma sheimmo ochelet, veshota mimma sheimmo shota, veeno motzi rei shemma yaharog et immo. vechevan sheyyatza laavir haolam — niftach hassatum, venistam happatuach, sheilmale ken eno yachol lichyot afillu shaa achat.
Vener daluk lo al rosho, vetzofe umabbit missof haolam vead sofo, shenneemar: "behillo nero ale roshi leoro elech choshech", veal titma, shehare adam yashen kan veroe chalom beaspamya.

Veen lecha yamim sheadam sharuy betova yoter meotan hayyamim, shenneemar: "mi yitteneni cheyarche kedem kime eloah yishmereni", veezehu yamim sheyyesh bahem yerachim veen bahem shanim? heve omer: ellu yarche leda.
Umelammedin oto kol hattora kullah, shenneemar: "vayyoreni vayyomer li yitmoch devaray libbecha shemor mitzvotay vechye", veomer: "besod eloah ale oholi".
May "veomer"? vechi tema navi hu dekaamar, ta shema "besod eloah ale oholi".
Vechevan shebba laavir haolam, ba malach vesotro al piv, umeshakkecho kol hattora kullah, shenneemar: "lappetach chattat rovetz".

Veeno yotze mishsham ad shemmashbiin oto, shenneemar: "ki li tichra kol berech tishshava kol lashon". "ki li tichra kol berech" — ze yom hammita, shenneemar: "lefanav yichreu kol yorde afar". "tishshava kol lashon" — ze yom halleda, shenneemar: "neki chappayim uvar levav asher lo nasa lashshav nafsho velo nishba lemirma".

Uma hi hashshevua shemmashbiin oto? tehi tzaddik veal tehi rasha, vaafillu kol haolam kullo omrim lecha "tzaddik atta" — heye beenecha kerasha. veheve yodea shehakkadosh baruch hu tahor, umeshartav tehorim, uneshama shennatan becha tehora hi. im atta meshammerah betohora — mutav, veim lav — hareni notlah mimmecha.
Tana deve rabbi yishmael: mashal lechohen shemmasar teruma leam haaretz, veamar lo: im atta meshammerah betohora — mutav, veim lav — hareni sorfah lefanecha.
Amar rabbi elazar:

a: May kera? "mimmee immi atta gozi". may mashma dehay "gozi" lishshana deishtevoe hu? dichtiv: "gozzi nizrech vehashelichi".
Veamar rabbi elazar: lema valad dome bime immo? leegoz munnach besefel shel mayim, adam noten etzbao alav — shokea lechan ulechan.

Tanu rabbanan: shelosha chodashim harishonim — valad dar bemador hattachton, emtzaiyyim — valad dar bemador haemtzai, acharonim — valad dar bemador haelyon, vechevan shehiggia zemanno latzet — mithappech veyotze, vezehu "chevle ishsha".
Vehayeynu ditnan: chevle (shel) nekeva merubbin mishshel zachar.
Veamar rabbi elazar: may kera? "asher usseti vasseter rukkamti betachtiyyot aretz". "darti" lo neemar, ella "rukkamti".
May shena chevle nekeva merubbin mishshel zachar? ze ba kederech tashmisho, veze ba kederech tashmisho, zo hofechet paneha, veze en hofech panav.

Tanu rabbanan: shelosha chodashim harishonim — tashmish kashe laishsha, vegam kashe lavvalad. emtzaiyyim — kashe laishsha veyafe lavvalad. acharonim — yafe leishsha veyafe lavvalad, shemmittoch kach nimtza havvalad melubban umezoraz.
Tana: hameshammesh mittato leyom tishim — keillu shofech damim. mena yada? ella amar abbaye: meshammesh veholech, veshomer petayim Adonai".

Tanu rabbanan: shelosha shuttafin yesh baadam — hakkadosh baruch hu, veaviv, veimmo. aviv mazria halloven, shemmimmennu atzamot, vegidim, vetzippornayim, umoach shebberosho, veloven shebbaayin. immo mazraat odem, shemmimmennu or, uvasar, usearot, veshachor shebbaayin. vehakkadosh baruch hu noten bo ruach, uneshama, ukelaster panim, ureiyyayt haayin, ushemiat haozen, vedibbur pe, vehilluch raglayim, uvina, vehasekel.
Vechevan shehiggia zemanno lehippater min haolam, hakkadosh baruch hu notel chelko vechelek aviv veimmo, manniach lifnehem. amar rav pappa: hayeynu deamri inashe "putz milcha ushedi bisra lechalba".

Daresh rav chinnana bar pappa: may dichtiv "ose gedolot ad en cheker veniflaot ad en mispar"? bo uree shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam. middat basar vadam, noten chefetz bechemet tzerura ufiha lemala — safek mishtammer, sefek en mishtammer. veillu hakkadosh baruch hu, tzar haubbar bime ishsha petucha ufiha lematta, umishtammer.
Davar acher: adam noten chafatzav lechaf moznayim, kol zeman shemmachbid yored lematta, veillu hakkadosh baruch hu, kol zeman shemmachbid havvalad ole lemala.

Daresh rabbi yose haggelili: may dichtiv "odcha (Adonai) al ki noraot nifleti niflaim maasecha venafshi yodaat meod"? bo uree shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam. middat basar vadam, adam noten zeronim baaruga kol (achat veachat) [echad veechad] ole bemino, veillu hakkadosh baruch hu tzar haubbar bime ishsha, vechullam olin lemin echad.
Davar acher: tzabba noten sammanin layyora — kullan olin letzeva echad, veillu hakkadosh baruch hu tzar haubbar bime ishsha, kol (achat veachat) [echad veechad] ole lemino.
Daresh rav yosef: may dichtiv "odcha Adonai ki anafta bi yashov appecha utenachameni", bamme hakkatuv medabber?

Bishne bene adam sheyyatzu lischora. yashav lo kotz leechad mehen, hitchil mecharef umegaddef. leyamim shama shettava sefinato shel chavero bayyam, hitchil mode umeshabbeach. lechach neemar: "yashov appecha utenachameni".
Vehayeynu deamar rabbi elazar: may dichtiv "ose niflaot (gedolot) levaddo uvaruch shem kevodo leolam"? afillu baal hannes eno makkir benisso.

Daresh rabbi chanina bar pappa: may dichtiv "orchi verivi zerita vechol derachay hiskanta"? melammed shello notzar adam min kol hattippa, ella min habbarur shebbah. tana deve rabbi yishmael: mashal leadam shezzore bevet haggeranot, notel et haochel umanniach et happesolet.
Kidrabbi avahu, derabbi avahu rame: ketiv "vattazreni chayil", uchetiv "hael hameazzereni chayil". amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, zeritani vezeraztani.

Daresh rabbi avahu: may dichtiv "mi mana afar yaakov umispar et rova yisrael"? melammed shehakkadosh baruch hu yoshev vesofer et reviiyyotehem shel yisrael, matay tavo tippa shehatztzaddik notzar hemenna.
Veal davar ze nismet eno shel bilam harasha, amar: mi shehu tahor vekadosh, umeshartav tehorim ukedoshim, yatzitz bedavar ze?! miyyad nismet eno, dichtiv: "neum haggever shetum haayin".
Vehayeynu deamar rabbi yochanan: may dichtiv "vayyishkav immah ballayla hu"? melammed shehakkadosh baruch hu siyyea beoto maase, shenneemar: "yissaschar chamor garem" — chamor garam lo leyissasochar.
Amar rabbi yitzchak, amar rabbi amme: ishsha mazraat techilla — yoledet zachar, ish mazria techilla — yoledet nekeva, shenneemar: "ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar".

Tanu rabbanan: barishona hayu omrim — ishsha mazraat techilla yoledet zachar, ish mazria techilla yoledet nekeva, velo pershu chachamim et haddavar, ad shebba rabbi tzadok ufersho: "elle bene lea asher yalda leyaakov befaddan aram veet dina vitto" — tala hazzecharim bannekevot unekevot bazzecharim.
"Vayyihyu vene ulam anashim gibbore chayil dorche keshet umarbim banim uvene vanim" — vechi beyado shel adam leharebot banim uvene banim? ella mittoch
b: Shemmeshahin atzman babbeten kede sheyyazriu neshotehen techilla, sheyyehu benehem zecharim — maale alehen hakkatuv keillu hem marbim banim uvene banim. vehayeynu deamar rav kattina: yacholni laasot kol banay zecharim. amar rava: harotze laasot kol banav zecharim — yivol veyishne.
Veamar rabbi yitzchak, amar rabbi amme: en ishsha mitabberet ella samuch levistah, shenneemar "hen beovon cholalti".
Verabbi yochanan amar: samuch (litvila) [litvilatah], shenneemar: "uvechet yechematni immi".
May mashma dehay "chet" lishshana dedakkoye hu? dichtiv "vechitte et habbayit", umetargeminan "vidakke yat beta". vei baet ema mehacha: "techatteeni beezov veethar".
Veamar rabbi yitzchak, amar rabbi amme: kevan shebba zachar baolam — ba shalom baolam, shenneemar "shilchu char moshel eretz". "zachar" — ze kar.
Veamar rabbi yitzchak deve rabbi amme: ba zachar baolam — ba kikkaro beyado, "zachar" — ze kar, dichtiv: "vayyichre lahem kera gedola".
Nekeva — en immah kelum, nekeva — nekiyyay baa, ad deamra: "mezone" — la yahavi la, dichtiv: "nokva secharcha alay veettena".

Shaalu talmidav et rabbi shimon ben yochay: mippene ma amra tora yoledet mevia korban? amar lahen: beshaa shekkoraat leled, kofetzet venishbaat shello tizzakek levalah, lefichach amra tora tavi korban.
Matkef la rav yosef: veha mezida hi, uvacharata talya milleta! veod — korban shevua (bae) [baaya] etoye!
Umippene ma amra tora zachar leshiva unekeva learbaa asar? zachar, shehakkol semechim bo — mitcharetet leshiva. nekeva, shehakkol atzevim bah — mitcharetet learbaa asar.
Umippene ma amra tora mila lishmona? shello yehu kullam semechim veaviv veimmo atzevim.
Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: mippene ma amra tora nidda leshiva? mippene sheragil bah vekatz bah. amra tora: "tehe temea shiva yamim", kede shettehe chaviva al balah kishat kenisatah lachuppa.

Shaalu talmidav et rabbi dostay berabbi yannay: mippene ma ish mechazzer al ishsha, veen ishsha mechazzeret al ish? mashal leadam (sheavad) [sheavda] lo aveda — mi mechazzer al mi? baal aveda mechazzer al avedato.
Umippene ma ish panav lematta, veishsha paneha lemala kelappe haish? ze mimmekom shennivra, vezo mimmekom shennivret.
Umippene ma haish mekabbel piyyus, veen ishsha mekabbelet piyyus? ze mimmekom shennivra, vezo mimmekom shennivret.
Mippene ma ishsha kolah arev, veen ish kolo arev? ze mimmekom shennivra, vezo mimmekom shennivret, shenneemar: "ki kolech arev umarech nave".
Hadaran alach hammappelet chaticha.
Mishna benot kutim niddot mearisatan, vehakkutim metammeim mishkav tachton kaelyon, mippene shehen boale niddot,
Vehen yoshvot al kol dam vadam.
Veen chayyayvin alehen al biat mikdash, veen sorfin alehem et hatteruma, mippene shettumeatan safek.
Gemara hechi dame? i deka chazyayn — afillu didan name, vei dela kachazyayn — didhu name la.
Amar rava bereh derav acha bar rav huna amar rav sheshet: hacha vemay askinan? bistama, dechevan deikka miuta dechazyayn — chayyshinan. uman tanna dechayesh lemiuta?

a: Rabbi meir hi, detanya: katan uketanna lo choltzin velo meyabbemin, divre rabbi meir.
Amru lo lerabbi meir: yafe amarta sheen choltzin, "ish" katuv bapparasha, umakkeshinan ishsha leish. uma taam en meyabbemin?
Amar lahen: katan — shemma yimmatze saris, ketanna — shemma timmatze aylonit, venimtzeu pogin beerva shello bimkom mitzva.
Verabbanan? zil batar rubba diktannim, verov ketannim lav sarisim ninhu; zil batar rubba diktannot, verov ketannot lav ayloniyyot ninhu.
Emar deshamat leh lerabbi meir miuta dishchiach, aval miuta dela shechiach — mi shamat leh?

Ha name miuta dishchiach hu. detanya: amar rabbi yose: maase been bul vehitbiluha kodem leimmah, veamar rabbi: maase bevet shearim vehitbiluha kodem leimmah. veamar rav yosef: maase befumebdita vehitbiluha kodem leimmah.

Bishlama derabbi yose uderabbi — mishshum terumat eretz yisrael, ella derav yosef lema li? veha amar shemuel: en terumat chutz laaretz asura ella bemi shettumea yotza miggufo, vehane mille baachila, aval bingia la!
Amar mar zutera: lo nitzrecha ella lesuchah shemen shel teruma, detanya: "velo yechallelu et kodshe bene yisrael asher yarimu laAdonai" — lerabbot et hassach veet hashshote.
Shota lema li kera? shetiyya bichlal achila! ella, lerabbot et hassach kashshote. veibbaet ema mehacha: "vattavo chammayim bekirbo vechashshemen beatzmotav".
I hachi didan name?

Anan, dedarshinan "ishsha" "veishsha", vechi chazyayn (mefarshe) [mafreshinan] lehu — la gezaru behu rabbanan. inhu dela darshi "ishsha" "veishsha", vechi chazyayn la mafreshi lehu — gezaru behu rabbanan.
May "ishsha" "veishsha"? detanya: "ishsha" — en li ella ishsha, tinoket bat yom echad lenidda minnayin? talmud lomar: "veishsha".
Alma, ki merabbe kera bat yom echad merabbe, ureminhu: "ishsha" — en li ella ishsha, tinoket bat shalosh shanim veyom echad levia minnayin? talmud lomar: "veishsha"!
Amar rava: hilcheta ninhu, veasmechinhu rabbanan akkerae. he kera vehe hilcheta? illema bat yom echad — hilcheta, bat shalosh shanim veyom echad — kera, kera setama ketiv!
Ella bat shalosh shanim veyom echad — hilcheta, bat yom echad — kera, umeachar dehilcheta, kera lamma li?
b: Lemaote ish meodem.
Veha detanya: ishsha — en li ella ishsha, bat asara yamim leziva minnayin? talmud lomar "veishsha". lema li? ligmar minnidda!

Tzericha, dei ketav rachamana benidda — hava amena: nidda, mishshum dechi chazay chad yoma baaya lemetav shiva; aval zava, dei chazay chad yoma — beshomeret yom keneged yom saggi la, ema la. tzericha.
Velichtov rachamana bezava, vela bae benidda, vaana yadana deen zava belo nidda. in hachi name! veella kera lema li? lemaote ish meodem.
Ha mayetteh chada zimna? chad lemaote mishshichvat zera, vechad lemaote middam.
Vechen leinyan zecharim. detanya: "ish ish" — ma talmud lomar "ish ish"? lerabbot tinok bin yom echad shehu metamme beziva, divre rabbi yehuda.

Rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: en tzarich, hare hu omer: "lazzachar velannekeva" — "lazzachar" kol shehu zachar, ben shehu gadol ben shehu katan, "velannekeva" kol shehi nekeva, ben gedola ben ketanna. im ken, ma talmud lomar "ish ish"? dibbera tora chilshon bene adam.
Alma, ki merabbe kera — ben yom echad merabbe. ureminhu: "ish" — en li ella ish, ben tesha shanim veyom echad minnayin? talmud lomar: "veish".
Amar rava: hilcheta ninhu, veasmechinhu rabbanan akkerae. he hilcheta vehe kera? illema ben yom echad — hilcheta, uven tesha shanim veyom echad — kera, kera setama ketiv!
Ella ben tesha shanim veyom echad — hilcheta, uven yom echad — kera. vechi meachar dehilcheta hi, kera lema li? lemaote ishsha milloven.
Lema li lemichtav bizcharim, ulema li lemichtav binkevot?
Tzerichi, dei ketav rachamana bizcharim — mishshum dimtammu biriyyot kivyamim, aval nekevot dela metammu biriyyot kivyamim — ema la.
Vei ketav rachamana binkevot — mishshum dekamtammu beones, aval zecharim dela metammu beones — ema la, tzericha.
Hakkutim metammein mishkav tachton kaelyon. may "mishkav tachton kaelyon"? illema dei ikka asara matztzaot veyatev alayyhu (metammu) [metamme] lehu, peshita! deha dares lehu.
Ella, sheyyehe tachtono shel boel nidda keelyono shel zav, ma elyono shel zav eno metamme ella ochlin umashkin, af tachtono shel boel nidda eno metamme ella ovchalin umashkin.
Elyono shel zav menalan? dichtiv: "vechol hannogea bechol asher yihye tachtav yitma", may "tachtav"?

a: Illema tachtav dezav — mivveish asher yigga bemishkavo" nafka! ella: hannogea bechol asher yihye hazzav tachtav, umay nihu — elyon shel zav.
"Vehannose" name yitma, umay nihu — nissa. may tama? "vehannissa" ketiv.
Nitteko hakkatuv mittumea chamura, vehevio lide tumea kalla, lomar lach sheeno metamme ella ovchalin umashkin.
Emar nitteko hakkatuv mittumea chamura, delo metamme adam letamme begadim, aval adam o begadim litamme? amar kera "yitma", tumea kalla mashma.
Vetachtono shel boel nidda menalan? detanya: "utehi niddatah alav",
Yachol yaale leraglah? talmud lomar "yitma shivat yamim".
Uma talmud lomar "utehi niddatah alav"? sheyyachol lo yetamme adam ucheli cheres, talmud lomar "utehi niddatah alav" — ma hi metammea adam ucheli cheres, af hu metamme adam ucheli cheres.
I ma hi osa mishkav umoshav letamme adam letamme begadim, af hu ose mishkav umoshav letamme adam letamme begadim? talmud lomar "vechol hammishkav asher yishkav alav yitma".

Sheen talmud lomar "vechol hammishkav asher yishkav alav yitma", uma talmud lomar "vechol hammishkav asher vegomer" — nitteko hakkatuv mittumea chamura vehevio lide tumea kalla, lomar lecha sheeno metamme ella ovchalin umashkin.
Parech rav achay: ema nitteko hakkatuv mittumea chamura vehevio letumea kalla — dela litamme adam letammoye begadim, aval adam uvegadim litamme! amar rav assi: "yitma" — tumea kalla mashma.
Ema: "utehi niddatah alav" — kalal, "vechol hammishkav" — parat, kelal uferat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat, mishkav umoshav — in, midde acharina — la!
Amar abbaye: "yitma shivat yamim" mafsek hainyan, have kelal uferat hameruchakin ze mizze, vechol kelal uferat hameruchakin ze mizze en danin oto bichlal uferat.
Rava amar: leolam danin, "vechol" — ribbuya hu.

Matkef la rabbi yaakov: ema kehi, ma hi — lo chillakta bah ben maggaah lemishkavah, letamme adam uletamme begadim lechumera, af hu — lo tachlok bo ben maggao lemishkavo, letamme adam uletamme begadim lekulla!
Amar rava: "alav" — lehateino mashma.
Mippene shehen boale niddot vechulei. attu kullehu boale niddot ninhu? amar rabbi yitzchak magdelaa: binsuot shanu.
Vehen yoshvot al dam vechulei. tanya, amar rabbi meir: im hen yoshvot al kol dam vadam — takkana gedola hi lahen,
Ella sheroot dam adom umashlimot oto ledam yarok.
Davar acher: yom shepposeket bo — sofarto leminyan shiva.
Matkef la rame bar chama: vetisperennu, vaanan name nispereh, dekayyma lan miktzat hayyom kechullo!
Amar rava: im ken, shichvat zera (dasetar) [desatra] beziva hechi mashkachat la? veha miktzat hayyom kechullo!
I dachazay befalga deyoma — hachi name, hacha vemay askinan? dachazay samuch lishkiat hachamma.
Velekum velema leh likra, ki ketiva — samuch lishkiat hachamma ketiva? in, al korchach shivkeh likra, deihu dachek umoke annafsheh.
Bae rame bar chama: poletet shichvat zera, mahu shettistor beziva? roa hayta vesoteret,
b: O dilma nogaat hayta vela satra?
Amar rava: lefum churepa shabbeshta! nehi name desatra, kema tistor? tistor shiva? dayya kevoalah!
Tistor yom echad "veachar tithar"? amar rachamana: "achar" — achar lechullan, shello tehe tumea mafseket benehem.
Velitamaych, zav gufeh hechi satar? "letohorato" amar rachamana: shello tehe tumea mafseket benehen!
Ella may it lach lememar? shello tehe tumeat ziva mafseket benehen, hacha name shello tehe tumeat ziva mafseket benehen.

Veen chayyayvin alehen al biat mikdash vechulei. rav pappa ikkela litvach, amar: i ikka tzureba merabbanan hacha, ezil akabbel appeh. amara leh hahi savta: ikka hacha tzureba merabbanan, verav shemuel shemeh, vetane matneyata. yehe raava detehve kevavteh!

Amar: middekamvarchi li begavvevy, shema minna yere shamayim hu. azal legabbeh, rema leh tora, rema leh matneyata ahadade: tenan "en chayyayvin alehen al biat mikdash, veen sorfin alehen et hatteruma, mippene shettumeatah safek" — alma missefeka la sarfinan teruma.
Ureminhi: al shishsha sefekot sorfin et hatteruma, al sefek bigde am haaretz!
Amar rav pappa: yehe raava delitachil hay tora lishlama, hacha vemay askinan? bechuti chaver.
Kuti chaver — boel nidda meshavvet leh?
Shavkeh, vaata lekammeh derav shimi bar ashe. amar leh: may tama la meshannet leh bechuti shettaval veala, vedaras al bigde chaver, vaazul bigde chaver unegau bitruma?
Dei mishshum tumeat am haaretz — ha tevel leh, vei mishshum boel nidda — safek baal bekarov, safek lo baal bekarov.
Veim timtze lomar baal bekarov, safek hishlimattu yarok, safek lo hishlimattu, vehave sefek sefeka, veassefek sefeka la sarfinan teruma.
Vetippok leh mishshum bigde am haaretz, deamar mar: bigde am haaretz midras lapperushin! amar leh: bechuti arom.

Mishna benot tzaddukin, bizman shennahagu lalechet bedarche avotehen — hare hen kechutiyyot. parshu lalechet bedarche yisrael — hare hen keyisreeliyyot. rabbi yose omer: leolam hen keyisreeliyyot, ad sheyyifreshu lalechet bedarche avotehen.

Gemara ibbaya lehu: setama may? ta shema: benot tzaddukin, bizman shennohagot lalechet bedarche avotehen — hare hen kechutiyyot. ha setama — keyisreeliyyot! ema sefa: pershu lalechet bedarche yisrael — hare hen keyisreeliyyot. ha setama — kechutiyyot! ella meha lekka lemishma minna.
Ta shema, ditnan: rabbi yose omer, leolam hen keyisreeliyyot, ad sheyyifreshu lalechet bedarche avotehen. mikkelal detanna kamma savar: setama kechutiyyot. shema minna.
Tanu rabbanan: maase betzadduki echad shessipper im kohen gadol bashshuk, venitteza tzinnora mippiv venafla lechohen gadol al begadav, vehoriku panav shel kohen gadol, vekadam etzel ishto.
Amra lo: af al pi shenneshe tzaddukim hen, mityarot min happerushim, umarot dam lachachamim.
Amar rabbi yose: bekiin anu bahen yoter min hakkol, vehen marot dam lachachamim, chutz meishsha achat shehayta bishchunatenu, shello herat dam lachachamim umeta.
Vetippok leh mishshum tzinnora deam haaretz! amar abbaye: betzadduki chaver. amar rava: tzadduki chaver boel nidda meshavvet leh? ella amar rava:

a: Regel hava, vetumeat am haaretz baregel ketohora shavveyuha rabbanan, dichtiv: "vayyeasef kol ish yisrael el hair keish echad chaverim", hakkatuv asaan kullan chaverim.
Mishna dam nochrit vedam tohora shel metzoraat, bet shammay metaharim, uvet hillel omrim: kerukkah uchememe ragleha.
Dam hayyoledet shello tavla, bet shammay omrim: kerukkah uchememe ragleha, uvet hillel omrim: metamme lach veyavesh.
Umodim beyoledet bezov shehi metammea lach veyavesh.

Gemara velet lehu levet shammay "dabber el bene yisrael veamarta alehem ish ish ki yihye zav" — bene yisrael metammein beziva, veen haggoyim metammein beziva, aval gazru alehen sheyyehu kezavin lechol divrehem?
Amri lach bet shammay: (hahu bizcharim ittemar, dei binkevot) hechi laaved? litamme lach veyavesh — asito keshel tora, littamme lach vela littamme yavesh — chillakta beshel tora.
I hachi, rukkah umeme ragleha name! kevan deavdinan hekkera bedamah, midda yedia derukkah umeme ragleha derabbanan.
Velaaved hekkera berukkah umeme ragleha, uletammoye ledamah? rukkah umeme ragleha dishchichi — gezaru behu rabbanan, damah dela shechiach — la gezaru beh rabbanan.
Amar rava: zovo tame, afillu levet shammay; kiryo tahor, afillu levet hillel.
Zovo tame, afillu levet shammay — deha ikka lemebad hekkera bekiryo.
Kiryo tahor, afillu levet hillel — avud beh rabbanan hekkera, ki hechi dela lisrof aleh teruma vekadashim.
Velaaved hekkera bezovo, uletammoye lekiryo? zovo dela tele bemaase — gezaru beh rabbanan, kiryo ditle bemaase — la gezaru beh rabbanan.

Lema mesayyay leh: nochrit sheppalta shichvat zera miyyisrael — temea, uvat yisrael sheppalta shichvat zera min hannochri — tehora. may lav tehora gemura? la, tehora middeorayyta, temea midderabbanan.
Ta shema: nimtzeta omer, shichvat zera shel yisrael temea bechol makom,
b: Vaafillu bime goya. veshel nochri tehora bechol makom, vaafillu bime yisreelit, chutz mimme raglayim shebbah.
Vechi tema, hachi name tehora middeorayyta, aval temea midderabbanan. attu me ragleha middeorayyta mi metammeu? ella shema minna: tehora afillu midderabbanan. shema minna.
Amar mar: shichvat zera shel yisrael temea bechol makom, afillu bime goya. tifshot devae rav pappa, devae rav pappa: shichvat zera shel yisrael bime goya mahu?
Betoch shelosha — la kamibbaya leh lerav pappa, ki kamibbaya leh — leachar shelosha may?
Yisrael dedayyeygi bemitzvot — chavil gufayyhu umasriach, goyim dela dayygi bemitzvot — la chavil gufayyhu velo masriach, o dilma: kevan deachli shekatzim uremasim — chavil gufayyhu umasriach? teku.
Dam tohora shel metzoraat, bet shammay kulei. may tama devet hillel? amar rabbi yitzchak: "lazzachar" — lerabbot metzora lemayenotav, "velannekeva" — lerabbot metzoraat lemayenoteha.
May mayenoteha? illema shear mayenoteha — mizzachar nafka! ella ledamah, letamme dam tohora shellah.
Uvet shammay? nekeva mizzachar la atya, deikka lemifrach: ma lezachar shekken taun peria uferima, veasur betashmish hammitta, tomar bannekeva dela.
Uvet hillel? lichtov rachamana binkeva vela bae zachar, vaana amena: uma nekeva, sheenah teuna peria uferima, veenah asura betashmish hammitta — rabbi rachamana mayenoteha, zachar — lo kol shekken?
Im eno inyan "lezachar" — tenehu inyan linkeva, veim eno inyan lemayenoteha — tenehu inyan ledamah, letamme dam tohora shellah.
Uvet shammay? zachar minnekeva la ate, deikka lemifrach: ma linkeva shekken metammea meones, tomar bezachar dela.
Uvet hillel? kayymi bimtzora, ufarchi mille dezav? uvet shammay? shum tumea parchi.
Veibbaet ema, amri lach bet shammay: hay "lezachar" mibbee leh, "lezachar" — kol shehu zachar, (hay), ben gadol ben katan. uvet hillel, nafka lehu mizzot torat hazzav" — ben gadol ben katan.
Amar rav yosef: ki fashet rabbi shimon ben lakish bezav, bae hachi: reiyyay rishona shel zav katan mahu shettetamme bemagga? "zot torat hazzav vaasher tetze mimmennu shichvat zara" amar rachamana.

Kol sheshshichvat zera shello (metamme) [metammea] — reiyyay rishona shello metammea, vehay kevan deshichvat zera shello lo metammea — reiyyay rishona name lo tetamme. o dilma, kevan deillu ihu chaze tarte — mitztarfa, metammeya?
Amar rava: ta shema, "zot torat hazzav" — ben gadol ben katan, ma gadol — reiyyay rishona shello metammea, af katan — reiyyay rishona name metammea.
Bae rav yosef: reiyyay rishona shel metzora mahu shettetamme bemassa? mekom ziva mayan hu umetamme, o dilma lav mayan hu?
Amar rava: ta shema, "zovo tame hu" — limmed al hazzov shehu tame. bemay? ilema bezav gereda

a: Laacherim gorem tumea, leatzmo lo kol shekken? ella peshita bezav metzora,
Umiddeitzterich kera lerabboye biriyyay sheniyya, shema minna: mekom ziva lav mayan hu.

Amar leh rav yehuda middiskarta lerava: mimmay? dilma leolam ema lach bezav gereda, udekaamrat laacherim gorem tumea, leatzmo lo kol shekken — sair hammishtalleach yochiach, sheggorem tumea laacherim, vehu atzmo tahor!

Amar abbaye: may tibbee leh, veha hu deamar "zot torat hazzav" — ben gadol ben katan, vechevan denafka leh mehatam, iyyaytar leh "lazzachar" lerabbot metzora lemayenotav, (nekeva) ["velannekeva"] lerabbot metzoraat lemayenoteha.
Veakkesheh rachamana metzora lezav gamur — ma zav gamur metamme bemassa, af reiyyay rishona shel metzora metamme bemassa.

Amar rav huna: reiyyay rishona shel zav metammea beones, shenneemar: "zot torat hazzav vaasher tetze mimmennu shichvat zara", ma shichvat zera metamme beones, af reiyyay rishona shel zav metammea beones.
Ta shema: raa reiyyay rishona — bodkin oto. may lav letumea? la, lekorban.
Ta shema: bashsheniyya bodkin oto. lemay? ilema lekorban, aval letumea la? ikkeri kan "mibbesaro" velo mechamat onso! ella lav letumea, umiddesefa letumea — resha name letumea?
Midde irya? ha kidita, veha kidita.
Ta shema: rabbi eliezer omer, af bashshelishi bodkin oto mippene hakkorban, mikkelal detanna kamma mippene hattumea kaamar!
La, dechulle alma lekorban, vehacha beettim" ka mippalgi: rabbanan la darshi "ettim", verabbi eliezer daresh "ettim".
Rabbanan la darshi "ettim": "hazzav" — chada, "zovo" — tarte, "lazzachar" — bashshelishi akkesheh rachamana linkeva.
Verabbi eliezer daresh "ettim": "hazzav" — chada, "et" — tarte, "zovo" — telat, barvii akkesheh rachamana linkeva.
Ta shema: rabbi yitzchak omer, vahalo zav bichlal baal keri haya, velamma yatza — lehakel alav ulehachmir alav; lehakel alav — sheen metamme beones, ulehachmir alav —
b: Shehu ose mishkav umoshav.
Emat? illema biriyyay sheniyya — hecha hava bichlal baal keri? ella peshita biriyyay rishona, vekatane lehakel alav sheeno metamme beones!
Vetisbera lehachemir alav shehu ose mishkav umoshav, biriyyay rishona bar mishkav umoshav hu?

Ella hachi kaamar, rabbi yitzchak omer: vahalo zav bichlal baal keri haya biriyyay rishona, velamma yatza biriyyay sheniyyay — lehakel alav ulehachmir alav, lehakel alav — sheeno metamme beones, ulehachmir alav — shehu ose mishkav umoshav.

Amar rav huna: zov dome leme vatzek shel seorim. zov ba mibbesar hammet, shichvat zera ba mibbesar hachay. zov — dehe, vedome leloven betza hammuzeret, shichvat zera keshura, vedoma leloven betza sheenah muzeret.
Dam hayyoledet shello tavla vechulei.

Tanya, amru lahen bet hillel levet shammay: i attem modim benidda shello tavla veraata dam, shehi temea? amru lahem bet shammay: lo, im amartem benidda sheafillu tavla veraata temea, tomru beyoledet sheim tavla veraata shehi tehora.
Amru lahem: yoledet bezov tochiach, sheim tavla veraata leachar yeme sefira — tehora, lo tavla veraata — temea!
Amru lahem: hu haddin, vehi hatteshuva.
Lememra difligi? vehatnan: umodim beyoledet bezov shehi metammea lach veyavesh!
La kashya — kan shessafra, kan shello safra.
Vehatanya: yoledet bezov shessafra velo tavla veraata, halchu bet shammay leshitatan, uvet hillel leshitatan.
Ittemar: rav amar: mayan echad hu — hattora timmeattu vehattora tiharattu.
Velevi amar: shene mayanot hem — nistam hattame niftach hattahor, nistam hattahor niftach hattame.
May benayyhu? ikka venayyhu: shofaat mittoch shiva leachar shiva, umittoch arbaa asar leachar arbaa asar, umittoch arbaim leachar arbaim, umittoch shemonim leachar shemonim.
Lerav — resha lekulla, vesefa lechumera;
Lelevi — resha lechumera, vesefa lekulla.
Metivi: dam hayyoledet shello tavla, bet shammay omrim: kerukkah uchememe ragleha, uvet hillel omrim: metamme lach veyavesh.
Ka salka datach defaska. bishlama lerav, deamar: mayan echad hu, mishshum hachi metamme lach veyavesh. ella lelevi, deamar: shene mayanot hen, ammay metamme lach veyavesh?
Amar lach levi: hacha vemay askinan? beshofaat, i beshofaat, may tama devet shammay? kasavri bet shammay: mayan echad hu.
Bishlama lelevi, hayeynu deikka ben bet shammay uvet hillel, ella lerav may benayyhu?
Ikka benayyhu yome utevila, devet shammay savri: beyome tela rachamana, uvet hillel savri: beyome utevila.
Ta shema, umodim beyoledet bezov shehi metammea lach veyavesh. salka datach hacha name defaska.
Bishlama lerav, deamar: mayan echad hu, mishshum hachi metamme lach veyavesh. ella lelevi, deamar: shene mayanot hen, ammay metamme lach veyavesh?
Amar lach: hacha name — beshofaat. i beshofaat, lemay itzterich?
Levet shammay itzterich, af al gav dekaamri bet shammay: mayan echad hu, uveyome tela rachamana — hane mille beyoledet geredta, dishlimu lehu yome, aval yoledet bezov devae sefira — la.
Ta shema: "devotah titma" — lerabbot et boalah.

"Devotah titma" — lerabbot hallelot, "devotah titma" — lerabbot hayyoledet bezov shetztzericha shetteshev shiva yamim nekiyyim. bishlama lerav deamar mayan echad hu, mishshum hachi baaya shiva yamim nekiyyim,

a: Ella lelevi deamar shene mayanot hen, lema li shiva? bemashshehu saggi!
Hachi kaamar: tzericha shettifsok mashshehu, sheyyaalu lah leshiva nekiyyim.
Ta shema: yeme ibburah olim lah lime menikutah, vime menikutah olim lah lime ibburah.
Ketzad hifsika shetayim bime ibburah, veachat bime menikutah; shetayim bime menikutah, veachat bime ibburah; achat umechetza bime ibburah, veachat umechetza bime menikutah — olin lah leshalosh onot.
Bishlama lerav deamar: mayan echad hu, mishshum hachi bae hefsek shalosh onot, ella lelevi deamar: shene mayanot hen, lema li hefsek shalosh onot? bemashshehu saggi!
Hachi kaamar: tzericha shettifsok mashshehu, kede sheyyaalu lah leshalosh onot.
Ta shema: veshavin beroa achar dam tohar, sheddayyah sheatah.
Bishlama lelevi deamar: shene mayanot hen, mishshum hachi dayyah sheatah, ella lerav deamar: mayan echad hu, ammay dayya sheatah? tetamme meet leet!
Delekka shehut.
Utetamme mippekida lifkida! kevan dimet leet lekka, mippekida lifkida name la gezaru ba rabbanan.
Ta shema: yoledet bezov shessafra velo tavla veraata, halchu bet shammay leshitatan, uvet hillel leshitatan.
Bishlama lerav, deamar: mayan echad hu, mishshum hachi metamme lach veyavesh. ella lelevi, deamar: shene mayanot hen, ammay metamme lach veyavesh?
Amar lach levi: ana daamari — ketanna deshavin.
Veibbaet ema: beshofaat, veha "safra" katane!
Hacha beyoledet nekeva bezov askinan, deshavua kamma paska, shavua batra la paska, vekasavar: yeme ledatah sheen roe bahen — olin lah lisfirat zivatah.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: amar lan rav shemen missichra: ikkela mar zutera leatrin, uderash: hilcheta kevavteh derav lechumera, vehilcheta kevavteh delevi lechumera.
Rav ashe amar: hilcheta kevavteh derav, ben lekulla ben lechumera. daresh marimar: hilcheta kevavteh derav, ben lekulla ben lechumera. vehilcheta kevavteh derav, ben lekulla ben lechumera.
b: Mishna hamekashsha — nidda. kishsheta shelosha yamim betoch achad asar yom, veshafta meet leet, veyalda — hare zo yoledet bezov, divre rabbi eliezer.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: layla vayom kelile shabbat veyomo, sheshshafta min hatztzaar velo min haddam.
Kamma hi kishshuyah? rabbi meir omer: afillu arbaim vachamishshim yom. rabbi yehuda omer: dayyah chodshah. rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim: en kishshuy yoter mishshete shabbatot.
Gemara attu kol hamekashsha nidda hi?
Amar rav: nidda leyoma. ushemuel amar: chayyshinan shemma tishpe.
Verabbi yitzchak amar: hamekashsha enah kelum. vehakatane: hamekashsha nidda!
Amar rava: bime nidda — nidda, bime ziva — tehora. vehatanya: hamekashsha bime nidda — nidda, bime ziva — tehora.
Ketzad? kishsheta yom echad, veshafta shenayim, o shekkishsheta shenayim veshafta yom echad, o sheshshafta vekishsheta vechazra veshafta — hare zo yoledet bezov.

Aval shafta yom echad vekishsheta shenayim, o sheshshafta shenayim vekishsheta yom echad, o shekkishsheta veshafta vechazra vekishsheta — en zo yoledet bezov. kelalo shel davar: koshi samuch lalleda — en zo yoledet bezov, shofi samuch lalleda — hare zo yoledet bezov.
Chananya ben achi rabbi yehoshua omer: kol shechal kishshuyah bashshelishi shellah, afillu kol hayyom kullo beshofi — en zo yoledet bezov.
"Kelalo shel davar" leetoye may? leetoye dachananya.
Mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "damah" — damah mechamat atzmah, velo mechamat valad.
Atta omer mechamat valad, o eno ella mechamat ones? keshehu omer "veishsha ki yazuv zov damah", hare ones amur. ha ma ani mekayyem "damah"? damah mechamat atzmah, velo mechamat valad.
Uma raita letaher et havvalad uletamme beones? metaher ani bavvalad — sheyyesh tohora acharav, umetamme ani beones — sheen tohora acharav.
Adderabba, metaher ani beones, shekken ones bezav tahor! hasheta miha beishsha kayyminan, veones beishsha la ashkechan.
Veibbaet ema: may dataych letahore beones, uletammoye bevalad? en lach ones gadol mizze!
I hachi, nidda name nema: "zava" — zovah mechamat atzmah, velo mechamat valad.
Atta omer valad, o eno ella ones? keshehu omer "veishsha ki tihye zava" — hare ones amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "zava"? zovah mechamat atzmah, velo mechamat valad!
Amar resh lakish: amar kera "teshev", yesh lecha yeshiva acheret shehi kazo, veezo zo? koshi bime ziva. veema: zo koshi bime nidda!
Ella amar avu dishmuel: amar kera "utemea shevuayim keniddatah" velo kezivatah, mikkelal dezivatah tahor, veezo zo — koshi bime ziva.
Vehasheta dichtiv "vetama shevuayim keniddatah", "damah" lema li? i lav "damah", hava amena keniddatah velo kezivatah, vaafillu beshofi. ka mashma lan.
Shela bar avina avad ovada kevavteh derav. ki ka nach nafsheh derav amar leh lerav assi: zil tzanneeh, vei la tzayet — garyeh. hu savar "gaddeyeh" amar leh.
Batar denach nafsheh derav, amar leh: "hadar bach", dahadar beh rav. amar leh: im ita dahadar beh, ledidi hava amar li. la tzayet gaddeyeh. amar leh: vela mistefe mar middelekta?

Amar leh: ana isi ben yehuda, dehu isi ben gur arye, dehu isi ben gamliel, dehu isi ben mahalalel — asita dinchasha dela shalet beh rikba. amar leh: vaana shela bar avina — buchena defarzela dimtabbar asita dinchasha.
Chalash rav assi. ayyeylu bechammime appeku mikkarire, ayyeylu bekarire appeku mechammime, nach nafsheh derav assi.

a: Azal shela, amar lidvethu: tzevit li zevavdta dela lezil velema leh lerav mille illavay. tzevita leh zevavdta. nach nafsheh deshela, chazo defarcha asa mehay pureya lehay pureya, amri: shema minna avadu rabbanan peyaysa.
Bae rava: koshi mahu shettistor beziva?
Davar hametamme soter, vehay name metamme kime nidda hu, o dilma davar haggorem soter, vehay lav gorem hu?
Amar leh abbaye: ones beziva yochiach, sheeno gorem, vesoter!
Amar leh: laye, hay name gorem hu, ditnan: raa reiyyay rishona — bodkin oto, sheniyya — bodkin oto, shelishit — en bodkin oto.
Ulerabbi eliezer, deamar: af bashshelishit bodkin oto, hachi name kevan dela garem la satar? amar leh: lerabbi eliezer, hachi name.
Ta shema: rabbi eliezer omer, af bashshelishit bodkin oto, barviit en bodkin oto. may lav listira?
La, letammoye lehahi tippa bemassa.
Ta shema: bashshelishit, rabbi eliezer omer bodkin oto, barviit en bodkin oto. lekorban amarti, velo listira.
Ella lerabbi eliezer, tifshot dedavar sheeno gorem soter, lerabbanan may?
Ta shema, detane avu derabbi avin: ma garam lo zovo — shiva, lefichach soter shiva; ma garam lo kiryo — yom echad, lefichach soter yom echad.
May shiva? illema dimtamme shiva — hay "ma zovo tame shiva" mibbae leh, ella lav davar haggorem soter, davar sheeno gorem eno soter? shema minna.
Amar abbaye: naktinan, en koshi soter beziva. vei mashkachat tanna deamar soter — hahu rabbi eliezer hi.
Tanya, rabbi marinus omer: en leda soteret beziva. ibbaya lehu: mahu shettaale? abbaye amar: enah soteret veenah ola. rava amar: enah soteret veola.
Amar rava: mena amena la? detanya: "veachar tithar" — "achar", "achar" lechullan, shello tehe tumea mafseket benehem.
I amrat bishlama ola — hayeynu dela mafseka tumea, ella i amrat enah ola — afsik leh leda! veabbaye amar lach: shello tehe tumeat ziva mafseket benehem.
Amar rava: mena amena la? detanya: "mizzovah" — "mizzovah" velo minnigah, "mizzovah" velo milledatah. veabbaye amar lach: teni chada "mizzovah" velo minnigah, vela titne "velo milledatah".

Verava, hay may? i amrat bishlama "mizzovah" velo milledatah, ayyeyde deitzterich leh leda, tena nigah attu leda. ella i amrat "mizzovah" velo minnigah, hay mivvechi yithar hazzav mizzovo" nafka — "mizzovo" velo minnigo!
Veabbaye — chad bezav vechad bezava. utzerichi, dei ketav rachamana
b: Bezav — mishshum dela metamme beones, aval zava — dimtammeya beones ema la, tzericha.
