Vei ketav rachamana bezava — mishshum dela metammeya biriyyot kivyamim, aval zav dimtamme biriyyot kivyamim — ema la, tzericha.
Amar abbaye: mena amena la? detanya: "devotah titma" — lerabbot et boalah.
"Devotah titma" — lerabbot et hallelot, "devotah titma" — lerabbot et hayyoledet bezov, shetztzericha shetteshev shiva nekiyyim.
May lav nekiyyim milleda? la, middam.

Veamar abbaye: mena amena la? detanya: "kime niddatah" — kach yeme ledatah, ma yeme niddatah en reuyin leziva veen sefirat shiva ola mehen, af yeme ledatah sheen reuyin leziva — en sefirat shiva ola mehen.
Verava, ha manni? rabbi eliezer hi, deamar: mistar name satra.
Vechi danin efshar mishshei efshar?

Amar rav achadvuy bar amme: rabbi eliezer hi, deamar danin efshar mishshei efshar. verav sheshet amar: al korchach hikkishan hakkatuv. ikka deamri: amar rav achadvuy bar amme amar rav sheshet: rabbi eliezer hi, deamar danin efshar mishshei efshar. verav pappa amar: al korchach hikkishan hakkatuv.
Kishsheta shelosha yamim vechulei.
Ibbaya lehu: shafta mizze umizze, mahu? rav chisda amar: temea, rabbi chanina amar: tehora.
Amar rabbi chanina: mashal lemelech sheyyatza, vachayaylotav lefanav — beyadua shechayaylotav shel melech hen.
Verav chisda amar: kol shekken devae nappesh chayyaylot tefe.
Tenan: rabbi yehoshua omer: layla vayom kelele shabbat veyomo, sheshshafta min hatztzaar velo min haddam. tama demin hatztzaar velo min haddam, ha mizze umizze — tehora. teyuveta derav chisda!

Amar lecha rav chisda: la mibbaya mizze umizze ditmea, defaski lehu chayyaylot ligmare, aval min hatztzaar velo min haddam, emar: ki hechi demiddam la paska, mikkoshi name la paska, veha tuneba bealma hu dinkat la, ka mashma lan.
Tenan: kishsheta shelosha yamim betoch achad asar yom, veshafta meet leet, veyalda — hare zo yoledet bezov.
Hechi dame? illema kidkatane, lema li shalosh? bitre bekoshi vechad beshofi saggi!
Ella lav hachi kaamar: kishsheta shelosha, veshafta mizze umizze, o shekkishsheta shenayim, veshafta meet leet — hare zo yoledet bezov, uteyuveta derabbi chanina!
Amar lach rabbi chanina: la, leolam kidkatane, veha ka mashma lan deaf al gav dematchel kishshuy bashshelishi, veshafta meet leet — temea, leappoke merabbi chanina.
Kamma hi kishshuyah? rabbi meir omer vechulei. hasheta chamishshim mekashsheya, arbaim mibbaya? amar rav chisda: la kashya — kan lechola, kan livria.
Amar rabbi levi: en havvalad metaher ella yamim haruyin lihyot bahen zava, verav amar: afillu beyamim haruyin lisfirat zava. amar rav adda bar ahava: uletameh derav

a: Afillu yamim haruyin lisfirat setirat zava.
Tenan: kamma hu kishshuyah? rabbi meir omer: arbaim vachamishshim yom.
Bishlama lerav, mashkachat la kerav adda bar ahava, ella lelevi — kashya.
Amar lach levi: mi katane "tehora bechullan"? bime nidda — nidda, bime ziva — tehora.
Lishshana acharina amri: amar rabbi levi: en havvalad metaher ella yamim haruyin lihyot bahen zava gedola. may tama? damah "yamim rabbim" ketiv.
Abba shaul mishshemeh derav amar: afillu yamim haruyin lihyot bahen zava ketanna, may tama? "yeme" vechol yeme" hatam ketivi.
Tenan: kamma hu kishshuyah? rabbi meir omer: afillu arbaim vachamishshim yom. kashya letarvayyhu! mi katane "tehora bechullan"? kishsheta bime niddatah — nidda, bime zivatah — tehora.
Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: yesh mekashsha mea vachamishshim yom, veen ziva ola bahen. ketzad? shenayim belo et.
Veshiva nidda, ushenayim shel achar hannidda, vachamishshim shehavvalad metaher.
Ushemonim shel nekeva, veshiva nidda, ushenayim shel achar hannidda.
Amru lo: im ken, yesh mekashsha kol yameha, veen ziva ola bahen!
Amar lahen: may datayychu? mishshum nefalim? en koshi linfalim.
Tanu rabbanan: yesh roa mea yom, veen ziva ola bahen. ketzad? shenayim belo et, veshiva nidda, ushenayim shel achar hannidda, ushemonim shel nekeva, veshiva nidda, ushenayim shel achar hannidda.
May ka mashma lan? leappoke mimman deamar i efshar liftichat hakkever belo dam, ka mashma lan deefshar liftichat hakkever belo dam.
Rabbi yehuda omer dayyah vechulei. tanya: rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi tarfon: dayyah chodshah, veyesh baddavar lehakel ulehachamir.
Ketzad? kishsheta shenayim besof shemini veechad bitchillat teshii, vaafillu bitchillat teshii yalda — hare zo yoledet bezov.
Aval kishsheta yom echad besof shemini ushetayim bitchillat teshii, vaafillu besof teshii yalda — en zo yoledet bezov.

Amar rav adda bar ahava: shema minna kasavar rabbi yehuda shippura garem. ini? veha amar shemuel: en ishsha mitabberet veyoledet ella lematayim veshivim veechad yom, o lematayim veshivim ushenayim yom, o lematayim veshivim ushelosha!
Hu deamar kachasidim harishonim, detanya: chasidim harishonim lo hayu meshammeshin mittotehen ella birvii beshabbat, shello yavou neshotehen
b: Lide chillul shabbat. birvii vetu la? ema: mervii veelach.
Amar mar zutera: may tamayyhu dachasidim harishonim? dichtiv "vayyitten [Adonai] lah herayon" — "herayon" begimatriyya matan veshivim vechad havu.

Amar mar zutera: afillu leman deamar yoledet letisha enah yoledet limkuttaim, yoledet leshiva yoledet limkuttaim, shenneemar "vayhi litkufot hayyamim vattahar channa vatteled ben", miut "tekufot" — shenayim, miut "yamim" — shenayim.

Rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim: en koshi yoter mishshete shabbatot. amar shemuel: may tamayyhu derabbanan? dichtiv: "vetama shevuayim keniddatah" — keniddatah velo kezivatah, mikkelal dezivatah tehora. vechamma shevuayim?
Tanu rabbanan: yesh mekashsha esrim vachamishsha yom, veen ziva ola bahen. ketzad? shenayim belo et, veshiva nidda, ushenayim shelleachar nidda, vearbaa asar shehavvalad metaher.
Vei efshar shettitkashshe esrim veshishsha yom belo valad, velo tehe yoledet bezov.
Belo valad? bitlata name saggi! amar rav sheshet: ema "bimkom sheyyesh valad". amar leh rava: veha "belo valad" katane!

Ella amar rava, hachi kaamar: i efshar shettitkashshe esrim veshishsha yom bimkom sheyyesh valad velo tehe yoledet bezov, uvimkom sheen valad ella nefel — bitlata name havya zava, may tama? en koshi linfalim.
Mishna hamekashsha betoch shemonim shel nekeva — kol damim shehi roa tehorin ad sheyyetze havvalad, verabbi eliezer metamme.
Amru lo lerabbi eliezer: uma bimkom shehechmir bedam hashshofi, hekel bedam hakkoshi; mekom shehekel bedam hashshofi, eno din shennakel bedam hakkoshi?
Amar lahen: dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon, mimma hekel aleha? mittumeat ziva, aval temea tumeat nidda.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "teshev" — lerabbot hamekashsha betoch shemonim shel nekeva, shekkol damim shehi roa tehorin ad sheyyatza havvalad, verabbi eliezer metamme.

Amru lo lerabbi eliezer: uma bimkom shehechmir beshofi shellifne havvalad, hekel beshofi shelleachar havvalad; mekom shehekel bekoshi shellifne havvalad, eno din shennakel bekoshi shelleachar havvalad?
Amar lahem: dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon, mimma hekel aleha? mittumeat ziva, aval metammea tumeat nidda.

Amru lo: hare anu meshivin lecha lashon acher, uma bimkom shehechmir beshofi shellifne havvalad — hekel bekoshi sheimmo. makom shehekel beshofi shelleachar havvalad — eno din shennakel bekoshi sheimmo?
Amar lahem: afillu attem meshivin kol hayyom kullo, dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon, mimma hekel aleha mittumeat ziva, aval metammea tumeat nidda.
Amar rava: beha zakkinhu rabbi eliezer lerabbanan, lav amritu "damah" — dama mechamat atzmah velo mechamat valad, hachi name "vetahara mimmekor dameha" — dameha mechamat atzmah velo mechamat valad.
Ema: bime nidda — nidda, bime ziva — tehora? amar kera "teshev" — yeshiva achat lechullan.
Mishna kol achad asar yom bechezkat tohora.

a: Yashva lah velo badka, shagga, neensa, hezida velo badka — tehora.
Higgia sheat vistah, velo badka — hare zo temea. rabbi meir omer: im hayta bemachave, vehiggia sheat vistah, velo badka — hare zo tehora, mippene shecharada mesalleket et haddamim.
Aval yeme hazzav vehazzava, veshomeret yom keneged yom — hare ellu bechezkat tumea.
Gemara lemay hilcheta? amar rav yehuda: lomar sheenah tzericha bedika. veha middekatane sefa: "yashva velo badka" — mikkelal dilchattechilla baaya bedika!
Sefa atan lime nidda, vehachi kaamar: kol achad asar bechezkat tohora, vela baaya bedika, aval bime niddatah — baaya bedika. yashva velo badka, shagga, neensa, hezida velo badka — tehora.
Rav chisda amar: la tzericha ella lerabbi meir, deamar: ishsha sheen lah veset asura leshammesh. hane mille bime niddatah, aval bime zivatah bechezkat tohora kayyma.
I hachi, ammay amar rabbi meir: yotzi velo yachzir olamit? dilma atya lekalkole bime nidda.

Ha middekatane sefa: "higgia sheat vistah velo badka" — mikkelal divishsha sheyyesh lah veset askinan! chassore michassera vehachi katane: kol achad asar bechezkat tohora, vesharya levalah, uvime nidda asura.
Bamme devarim amurim? beishsha sheen lah veset, aval yesh lah veset mutteret, utzericha bedika. yashva velo badka, shagga, neensa, hezida velo badka — tehora. higgia sheat vistah velo badka — temea.

Ha middesefa rabbi meir, resha lav rabbi meir! kulla rabbi meir hi, vehachi kaamar: im lo hayta bemachave vehiggia sheat vistah velo badka — temea, sherabbi meir omer: im hayta bemachave vehiggia sheat vistah velo badka — tehora, shecharada mesalleket et haddamim.
Rava amar: lomar sheenah metammea meet leet.
Metivi: hannidda, vehazzava, vehashshomeret yom keneged yom, vehayyoledet — kullan metammeot meet leet. teyuveta!
Rav huna bar chiyyay amar shemuel: lomar sheenah kovaat lah veset betoch yeme zivatah. amar rav yosef: la shemia li ha shemateta.

Amar leh abbaye: at amart nihalan, veaha amart lan: hayta lemuda lihyot roa yom chamishsha asar (yom), veshinneta leyom esrim — ze vaze asurin leshammesh. shinneta paamayim leyom esrim — ze vaze asurin.

Vaamart lan ala, amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: la shena ella chamishsha asar litvilatah, shehen esrim ushenayim liriyyatah, dehatam bime niddatah kae la, aval chamishsha asar liriyyatah, devime zivatah kae — la kava.
Amar rav pappa: amrita lishmata kammeh rav yehuda middiskarta, mikba la kava, mechash mahu denechush la?
Ishtik vela amar leh vela mide. amar rav pappa: "nechze anan", hayta lemuda lihyot roa leyom chamishsha asar veshinneta leyom esrim — ze vaze asurin.
b: Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: la shena ella chamishsha asar litvilatah, shehen esrim ushenayim liriyyaytah,
Veshinneta leyom esrim veshiva; dechi hadri veatu esrin vetarte — kayyma la betoch yeme zivatah, vekatane: ze vaze asurin — alma dechayyshinan la.
Vekasavar rav pappa: esrin vetarten — meesrin vetarten manenan, nidda ufitchah — meesrin veshiva manenan.
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa: mimmay? dilma esrin vetarten name meesrin veshiva manenan, dechi hadri veatu esrin vetarten — kayyma la betoch yeme niddutah.
Vehachi name mistabbera; dei la tema hachi, hay tarnegolta deramya yoma vechavsha yoma, veramya yoma vechavsha yoma, vechavsha tere yome veramya chad yoma,
Ki hadra nakta — kedilkammeh nakta, o kidmeikkara nakta? al korchach kedilkammeh nakta.

Amar leh rav pappa: ella ha deamar resh lakish: ishsha kovaat lah veset betoch yeme zivatah, veen ishsha kovaat lah veset betoch yeme niddutah. verabbi yochanan amar: ishsha kovaat lah veset betoch yeme niddutah — hechi dame?
Lav kegon dachazay resh yarcha, vechamsha beyarcha, veresh yarcha, vechamsha beyarcha, vehasheta chazay bechamsha beyarcha, uveresh yarcha la chazay,
Vekaamar: ishsha kovaat lah veset betoch yeme niddutah, alma meresh yarcha manena!
Amar leh: la, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: kegon dachazay resh yarcha, veresh yarcha, veesrin vechamsha beyarcha, veresh yarcha, deamrinan dame yattiri hu deittosafu ba.
Vechen ki ata ravin vechol nachote yamma, amruha kerav huna bereh derav yehoshua.
Hadaran alach benot kutim.

a: Mishna yotze dofen — en yoshvin alav yeme tumea vime tohora, veen chayyayvin alav korban. rabbi shimon omer: hare ze keyalud.
Kol hannashim metammeot babbayit hachitzon, shenneemar: "dam yihye zovah bivsarah", aval hazzav uvaal keri enan metammein, ad shettetze tumeatan lachutz.
Haya ochel bitruma, vehirgish shennizdazeu evarav — ochez baamma uvolea et hatteruma, umetammein bechol shehu, afillu keen hachardal, uvefachot mikken.
Gemara amar rabbi mani bar pattish: may tamayyhu derabbanan? amar kera "ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar" — ad shetteled bimkom shehi mazraat.
Verabbi shimon? hahi — daafillu lo yalda ella keen shehizria, immo temea leda.
Verabbi shimon, may tameh? amar resh lakish: amar kera "teled" — lerabbot yotze dofen.
Verabbanan? hay mibbee leh lerabbot tumetum veanderoginos, desalka datach amena: "zachar" unekeva" ketiv — zachar vadday, nekeva vaddait, velo tumetum veanderoginos, ka mashma lan.
Verabbi shimon? nafka leh middetane bar levay, detane bar levay: "leven" — leven mikkol makom, "levat" — levat mikkol makom.
Verabbanan? hay mibbee leh lechayyev al kol ben uven, ulechayyev al kol bat uvat.
Verabbi shimon? nafka leh middetane tanna kammeh derav sheshet: "zot torat hayyoledet", melammed shemmevia korban echad al veladot harebe. yachol tavi al leda veal ziva keechat?
Ella, yoledet deachla dam veyoledet deachla chelev, bechad korban tisge la?
Ella, yachol tavi al leda shellifne melot veal leda shelleachar melot keachat? talmud lomar "zot". verabbanan, af al gav dichtiv "zot", itzterich "leven o levat".
Salka datach amena: bitre ibbure (dechad have nefel), aval bechad ibbura, kegon yehuda vechizkiyya bene rabbi chiyyay, emar bechad korban saggi la — ka mashma lan.
Amar rabbi yochanan: umode rabbi shimon bekadashim sheeno kadosh. may tama? gamar "leda" "leda" mibbechor — ma hatam "peter rechem", af kan "peter rechem".
Veligmar "leda" "leda" meadam — ma hatam yotze dofen, af kan yotze dofen!
Mistabbera mibbechor hava leh lemelaf, shekken immo meimmo", adderabba, meadam hava leh lemelaf, shekken pashut mippashut!
Ella, mibbechor hava leh lemelaf, shekken im behemat kadashim, piggul, notar, vetame.
Adderabba, meadam hava leh lemelaf, shekken pashut, zachar, kadosh, bemattana! hanach nefishan.
Amar rav chiyyay bereh derav huna mishshemeh derava: tanya dimsayyay leh lerabbi yochanan, rabbi yehuda omer: "zot torat haola hi haola" — hare ellu shelosha miutin,
b: Parat lenishchata ballayla, veshennishpach damah, vesheyyatza damah chutz lakkelaim sheim alta tered.

Rabbi shimon omer: ola — en li ella ola keshera, minnayin lerabbot shennishchata ballayla, veshennishpach damah, vesheyyatza damah chutz lakkelaim, vehallan, vehayyotze, vehattame, vehannotar, veshennishchat chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo,

Veshekkibbelu pesulin vezarku et daman, vehannittanin lemala shennetanan lematta, vehannittanin lematta shennetanan lemala, vehannittanin bachutz shennetanan bifnim, vehannittanin bifnim shennetanan bachutz, vehappesach vehachattat sheshshechatan shello lishman, minnayin?
Talmud lomar: "zot torat haola" — ribba tora achat lechol haolin, sheim alu lo yerdu.
Yachol sheani merabbe et harovea, vehannirba, vehammuketze, vehanneevad, veetnan, vehamechir, vehakkilayim, vehatterefa, veyotze dofen? talmud lomar "zot".
Uma raita lerabbot et ellu ulehotzi et ellu?

a: Achar sheribba hakkatuv umiet, amarta: merabbe ani et ellu shehaya pesulan bakkodesh, umotzi ani et ellu shello haya pesulan bakkodesh.
Katane mihat yotze dofen dela, may lav yotze dofen dekadashim? amar rav huna bereh derav natan: la, yotze dofen divchor.
Bechor — mippeter rechem" nafka!
Ella may, dekadashim? meimmo" "immo" nafka!
Hay may? i amrat bishlama dekadashim — hayeynu deitzterichi tere kerae; chad levehemat chullin deolid derech dofen veakdesha,
Vechad levehemat kadashim deolid derech dofen, vekasavar valdot kadashim bahavayaytan hen kedoshim. ella i amrat divchor — mippeter rechem" nafka!
Hachi name mistabbera, middekatane: "harovea vehannirba vehammuketze vehanneevad vehakkilayim".

Hane mehacha nafka? mehatam nafka! "min habbehema" — lehotzi harovea vehannirba, "min habbakar" — lehotzi et hanneevad, "min hatztzon" — lehotzi et hammuketze, "umin hatztzon" — lehotzi et hannogeach.
Vetu, kilayim mehacha nafka? mehatam nafka: "shor o chesev o ez" — "shor" perat lechilayim, "o ez" perat lenidme!
Ella, itzterichu tere kerae: chad levehemat chullin, vechad levehemat kadashim. hacha name: itzterich tere kerae.
Tanu rabbanan: hamekashsha shelosha yamim, veyatza valad derech dofen — hare zo yoledet bezov, verabbi shimon omer: en zo yoledet bezov, vedam hayyotze mishsham tame, verabbi shimon metaher.
Bishlama resha — rabbi shimon letameh verabbanan letamayyhu, ella sefa bemay peligi? amar ravina: kegon sheyyatza valad derech dofen
b: Vedam derech rechem, veazda rabbi shimon letameh verabbanan letamayyhu.
Matkef la rav yosef: chada — dehayynu resha, veod — "mishsham" mekom valad mashma!
Ella amar rav yosef: kegon sheyyatza valad vedam derech dofen,
Uvemakor mekomo tame kamippalgi; mar savar: makor mekomo tame, umar savar: makor mekomo tahor.
Amar resh lakish: ledivre hametamme baddam — metamme baishsha, ledivre hametaher baddam — metaher baishsha. verabbi yochanan amar: af ledivre hametamme baddam — metaher baishsha.

Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh, deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: minnayin sheen ishsha temea ad sheyyetze madveha derech ervatah? shenneemar: "veish asher yishkav et ishsha dava vegilla et ervatah et mekorah heera", melammed sheen ishsha temea ad sheyyetze madveha derech ervatah.
Amar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yehuda nesia: makor shenneekar venafal laaretz — temea, shenneemar: "yaan hishshafech nechushtech vattiggale ervatech".
Lemay? ilema letumeat shiva — dam amar rachamana, velo chaticha! ella letumeat erev.

Amar rabbi yochanan: makor shehizzia kishte tippe margaliyyot — temea. lemay? ilema letumeat shiva — chamishsha damim temein baishsha vetu la! ella letumeat erev. vedavvka tarte, aval chada — ema mealma atya.
Kol hannashim metammein babbayit hachitzon. he nihu bayit hachitzon? amar resh lakish: kol shettinoket yoshevet venirat.
Amar leh rabbi yochanan: oto makom galuy hu etzel sheretz! ella amar rabbi yochanan: ad ben hashshinnayim.
Ibbaya lehu: ben hashshinnayim kelifnim o kelachutz? ta shema, detane rabbi zakkay: ad ben hashshinnayim, ben hashshinnayim atzman kelifnim.
Bematnita tana: mekom disha. may "mekom disha"? amar rav yehuda: mekom shehashshammash dash.
Tanu rabbanan: "bivsarah" — melammed shemmetammea bifnim kevachutz, veen li ella nidda, zava minnayin? talmud lomar "zava bivsarah".
Poletet shichvat zera, minnayin? talmud lomar "yihye". verabbi shimon omer: dayyah kevoalah — ma boalah eno metamme ad shettetze tumea lachutz, af hi enah metammea ad shettetze tumeatah lachutz.

Vesavar rabbi shimon dayyah kevoalah? vehatanya: "verachatzu vammayim vetamu ad haarev", amar rabbi shimon: vechi ma ba ze lelammedenu? im leinyan nogea beshichvat zera — hare kevar neemar lematta: "o ish".
Ella, mippene shettumeat bet hassetarim hi, vetumeat bet hassetarim enah metammea, ella sheggezerat hakkatuv hi!
La kashya — kan bimshammeshet, kan befoletet.
Poletet — tippok leh, deha shimmesha! beshettavla leshimmushah.
Lememra dimshammeshet betumeat erev saggi la? veha amar rava: meshammeshet — kol shelosha yamim asura leechol bitruma, shei efshar lah shello tiflot.
Hacha vemay askinan? shehitbiluha bammitta, mikkelal dechi kaamar rava deazla ihi bechara vetavla, dilma bahade dekaazla shedete?

a: Vechi tema dilma ishteyayr — i hachi, "chayyshinan shema nishtayyer" mibbee leh!
Ella: lerava name, shehitbiluha bammitta, vela kashya: kan bemithappechet, kan besheenah mithappechet.

Verava akkera kae, vehachi kaamar: ki ketav rachamana "verachatzu vammayim vetamu ad haarev" besheenah mithappechet, aval bemithappechet kol shelosha yamim asura leechol bitruma, shei efshar lah shello tiflot.
Bea minneh rav shemuel bar bisna meabbaye: poletet shichvat zera, roa havya o nogaat havya?
Nafka minna listor, uletamme bemashshehu, uletamme bifnim kevachutz.
Ma nafshach? i shemia leh matnitin — lerabbanan roa havya, ulerabbi shimon nogaat havya.
Vei la shemia leh matnitin, mistabbera nogaat havya!
Leolam shemia leh matnitin, veallibba derabbanan — la kamibbaya leh, ki ka mibbaya leh — allibba derabbi shimon.
Uletamme bifnim kevachutz — la kamibbaya leh, ki kamibbaya leh — listor uletamme bechol shehu, may?
Ki kaamar rabbi shimon dayyah kevoalah — hane mille letammoye bifnim kevachutz, aval listor uletamme bechol shehu — roe havya, o dilma la shena?
Ikka deamri, leolam la shemia leh matnita, vehachi kamibbaya leh: middeachmayr rachamana abbaale kerayin besinay — roa havya.
O dilma: la gamrinan missinay, dechiddush hu, deha zavin umetzoraim dachamiri, vela achmayr behu rachamana.
Amar leh: roa havya. ata shayyleh lerava, amar leh: roa havya. ata lekammeh derav yosef, amar leh: roa havya. hadar ata lekammeh deabbaye, amar leh: kullechu berukka chada tafitu.
Amar leh: shappir amri lach, ad kan la kaamar rabbi shimon dayyah kevoalah ella letamme bifnim kevachutz, aval listor uletamme bechol shehu — roa havya.
Tanu rabbanan: hannidda, vehazzava, vehashshomeret yom keneged yom, vehayyoledet — kullan metammeot bifnim kevachutz.
Bishlama kullehu — lechayye, ella yoledet: i bime nidda — nidda, i bime ziva — ziva!
La tzericha — sheyyarda litbol mittumea letohora.
Vechi ha deamar rabbi zera, amar rabbi chiyyay bar ashe, amar rav: yoledet sheyyarda litbol mittumea letohora, veneekar mimmenna dam bayyerida — temea, baaliyyay — tehora.
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: bayyerida ammay temea? tumea belua hi! amar leh: zil shayyleh lerabbi avin, deasbarit nihaleh, vecharkesh li beresheh be midresha.
Azal shayyleh, amar leh: asauha kenivlat of tahor shemmetammea begadim bevet habbelia. mi dame?
b: Hatam en lah tumea bachutz, hacha ki nafek levaray litamme! hacha name kesheyyatza lachutz.
I yatza lachutz — may lememra? mahu detema: miggo demahane tevila ledam deikka gavvay, tahane name lehay — ka mashma lan.
Shematin ipperik, ella yoledet: i bime nidda — nidda, i bime ziva — ziva.
Hacha bemay askinan? beleda yabbishta. leda yabbishta, may metamme bifnim kevachutz ikka?
Kegon shehotzi valad rosho chutz lapperozdor, vechidrav oshaya, deamar rav oshaya: gezera shemma yotzi havvalad rosho chutz lapperozdor.

Vechi hahu daata lekammeh derava, amar leh: mahu lemimhal beshabbeta? amar leh: shappir dame. batar dinfak, amar rava: salka datach dehahu gavra la yada dishre lemimhal beshabbeta?! azal batreh, amar leh: ema li izi, gufa deovada hechi hava?

Amar leh: shemait valad detzavetz appanya demaale shabbeta, vela ityelid ad shabbeta. amar leh: hay hotzi rosho chutz lapperozdor hu, vehave mila shello bizmannah, vechol mila shello bizmannah en mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat.
Ibbaya lehu: oto makom shel ishsha, balua have o bet hassetarim have?

Lemay nafka minna — kegon shettachava lah chavertah kezayit nevela beoto makom. i amrat balua have — tumea belua la metammea, vei amrat bet hassetarim have — nehi divmagga la metammeya, bemassa miha metammeya!
Abbaye amar: balua have, rava amar: bet hassetarim have. amar rava: mena amena la? detanya: "ella mippene shettumeat bet hassetarim hi".
Vetumeat bet hassetarim lo metammea, ella sheggezerat hakkatuv hi.
Veabbayye, chada veod kaamar: chada, detumea belua hi; veod, afillu im timtze lomar tumeat bet hassetarim hi — enah metammea, ella sheggezerat hakkatuv hi.
Ibbaya lehu: mekom nivlat of tahor — balua have, o bet hassetarim have?

Lemay nafka minna? kegon shettachav lo chavero kezayit nevela letoch piv. i amrat balua have — tumea belua la metammeya, (ella i) [vei] amrat bet hassetarim have — nehi name divmagga lo metamme, bemassa miha metamme.

Abbaye amar: balua have, verava amar: bet hassetarim have. amar abbaye: mena amena la? detanya: yachol tehe nivlat behema metammea begadim abbet habbelia? talmud lomar: "nevela uterefa lo yochal letoma vah".
Mi sheen lah tumea ella achilatah — yatzta zo shettemea kodem sheyyochlenna.
Vetete bekal vachomer minnivlat of tahor, uma nivlat of tahor sheen lah tumea bachutz — yesh lah tumea bifnim, zo sheyyesh lah tumea bachutz — eno din sheyyesh lah tumea bifnim?
Amar kera: "bah" — bah velo beacheret.
Im ken, ma talmud lomar "vehaochel"?
Litten shiur lenogea ulenose, keochel — ma ochel bichzayit, af nogea venose bichzayit.
Amar rava: sheretz bekummeto — tahor, nevela bekummeto — tame.
Sheretz bekummeto, tahor — sheretz bingia hu dimtamme, uvet hassetarim lav bar magga hu. nevela bekummeto, tame — nehi divmagga la metamme, bemassa miha metamme.
